entries.Original:
If you see the ID constantly changing, that's a sign that the Retarget is constantly being Partially Overwritten.

This occurs when two different Retargets keep being registered, which do not fully overwrite each other (they do not share the same Replaced Actions).
Usually this is when you have a retargeting of an action in Feature and also in a Main Combo, and is a sign that both/all the Retargets will likely work.

通常是你既在功能中又在主连招中对某个技能进行了重定向，这表明两个/所有重定向很可能都会生效。

entries.Original:
Tanks have had their In-Combo Mitigation completely overhauled.
No longer is their mitigation settings in each combo, and no longer is mitigation entirely triggered by HP%.
Mitigation is now in its own Section, under the Advanced Combos, and those options apply to the Advanced Combos
if they have 'Include Mitigations' checked.
(Simple Modes will use the recommended values for these settings, if 'Include Mitigations' is checked there)

You can find these moved mitigation settings here:
PvE Features > [Tank of choice] > Advanced Mitigation Options

Make sure Mitigation is enabled in combos for these to work:
PvE Features > [Tank of choice] > Advanced/Simple Combo > Include Mitigations
entries.Translated:
坦克的连招内减伤已完全重做。

减伤现在位于独立分区，在高级连招下，若勾选“包含减伤”，这些选项将应用于高级连招。
（若在简单模式中勾选“包含减伤”，将使用这些设置的推荐值）

你可以在以下位置找到迁移后的减伤设置：
PvE 功能 > [所选坦克] > 高级减伤选项

请确保在连招中启用减伤，这些设置才会生效：
PvE 功能 > [所选坦克] > 高级/简单连招 > 包含减伤

entries.Original:
These buttons replace the need to replace actions for all features marked as either Simple or Advanced. Enable the type of combo you're wanting to use custom actions for, and drag the icon to your hotbar.

This frees up the actions for manual use, for example, for downtime where you only want to use 1-2-3 combos, or for healers to always have access to basic healing actions.

这样可以释放动作以供手动使用，例如在只需要使用1-2-3连击的空档期，或让治疗职业始终可以使用基础治疗动作。

entries.Original: Uses Wardens Paeon when someone in the party has a cleansable debuff using the Retargeting Function following party list.
entries.Translated: 当队伍中有人带有可除垢的减益时，按照队伍列表使用重新选目标功能施放光阴神之诗。

entries.Original: Stop using Buffs on targets below this HP % (0 = always use, 100 = never use).
entries.Translated: 当目标HP低于此百分比时停止使用增益（0 = 始终使用，100 = 从不使用）。

entries.Original: Adds Bloodletter when at max charges
entries.Translated: 在满层数时添加失血箭

entries.Original: Adds Rain of Death when at max charges, or bloodletter below level.
entries.Translated: 满层时加入死亡箭雨，或等级不足时加入失血箭。

entries.Original: Iron Jaws will only show up when debuffs are about to expire.
entries.Translated: 仅在减益即将结束时显示伶牙俐齿。

entries.Original: Adds Apex and Blast Arrow to Iron Jaws when available.
entries.Translated: 可用时将巅峰和爆破箭加入伶牙俐齿。

entries.Original: Also use Pray whenever the buff is missing, not only below the HP threshold.
entries.Translated: 当增益缺失时也使用祈祷，不仅限于低于血量阈值时。

entries.Original: When disabled, prefers the lowest-HP party member under the threshold.
entries.Translated: 禁用时，优先选择低于阈值中血量最低的队伍成员。

entries.Original: Max target distance (yalms) to use Phantom Kick
entries.Translated: 使用踢击的最大目标距离（米）

entries.Original: Self or average party HP % at or below which to use Blessing
entries.Translated: 自身或队伍平均血量百分比低于或等于此值时使用天之恩典

entries.Original: Self or average party HP % at or below which to prioritize Judgment as a heal
entries.Translated: 自身或队伍平均血量百分比低于或等于此值时优先将制裁作为治疗

entries.Original: Use Invulnerability before Starfall when Prediction of Starfall is up.
entries.Translated: 当陨石预言存在时，在落星池前使用不死宣告。

entries.Original: Use Suspend while out of combat.
Only use Occult Toad with 2+ targets in range, or when raidwide damage is incoming.
entries.Translated: 仅在范围内有2个以上目标，或即将受到全屏伤害时使用魔蛙变。

entries.Original: Refresh Occult Libra when remaining time is at or below this many seconds.
entries.Translated: 当剩余时间小于或等于该秒数时，刷新魔侦测。

entries.Original: Blazing Spellblade also refreshes at 30s remaining so other Spellblades do not take its cooldown.
entries.Translated: 魔法剑·核爆在剩余 30 秒时也会刷新，以免其他魔法剑占用其冷却。

entries.Original: When disabled, also triggers if the lowest party member is below the HP threshold.
entries.Translated: 禁用时，若血量最低的队员低于血量阈值也会触发。

entries.Original: When disabled, also triggers if any party member is below the MP threshold.
entries.Translated: 禁用时，若任意队员低于魔力阈值也会触发。

entries.Original: Retarget to Out of Party Players
entries.Translated: 重新选目标至队外玩家

entries.Original: Also retargets if anyone outside your party falls below this HP%
entries.Translated: 若队伍外任意玩家血量低于该百分比也会重新选目标

entries.Original: Use for damage (respects Restrict to Buff).
entries.Translated: 用于输出（遵循限制增益）。

entries.Original: Only when your HP is at or below the heal threshold.
entries.Translated: 仅当自身血量低于或等于治疗阈值时。

entries.Original: Only when your HP is at or below the emergency threshold.
entries.Translated: 仅当自身血量低于或等于紧急阈值时。

entries.Original: Necromancer spells while Drain Touch is active:
entries.Translated: 吸血触生效期间的死灵法师法术：

entries.Original: Cast Deep Freeze / Hell Wind / Chaos Drive / Doomsday only while Drain Touch is down.
entries.Translated: 仅在吸血触未生效时施放深度冻结 / 地狱之风 / 混沌疾雷 / 末日审判。

entries.Original: Cast those spells only during the Drain Touch buff.
entries.Translated: 仅在吸血触增益期间施放这些法术。

entries.Original: Ignore Drain Touch buff for spell usage.
entries.Translated: 施放法术时忽略吸血触增益。
仅在 4 层必杀强化时

entries.Original: Keep Defend for when you have full Finishing Fervor stacks.
entries.Translated: 保留防御，直到必杀强化层数满时使用。

entries.Original: When both Blind and Paralysis can apply:
entries.Translated: 当失明和麻痹均可施加时：
当两者均无法施加时（免疫/已达上限）：

entries.Original: Refresh this buff or debuff when remaining time is at or below this many seconds. 0 waits until it drops.
entries.Translated: 当剩余时间小于或等于该秒数时刷新此增益或减益。0 表示等到其消失。

entries.Original: Anti-Drift Options:     (hover each for more info)
entries.Translated: 防漂移选项：     （悬停查看详情）

entries.Original:
Forces a triple weave of Flourish and Fan Dance 3 + 4 during non-opener burst windows.
Fixes SS/FM drift where you use a gcd when SS/FM is on a 0.5sec CD.
Recommended anti-drift option.
entries.Translated:
在非起手爆发窗口期间强制三插百花争艳和扇舞·序 3 + 4。
修复 SS/FM 漂移，即当 SS/FM 处于 0.5 秒 CD 时使用 GCD。
推荐的防漂移选项。

entries.Original:
Will hold GCDs for Standard Step if it is going to come off cooldown before your next GCD.
This WILL give you down-time.
ONLY recommended if you have extra skill speed, but can be used as an anti-drift option.
entries.Translated:
如果标准舞步将在你的下一个 GCD 之前冷却完毕，则为其保留 GCD。
这会导致你出现空闲时间。
仅在你有多余技能速度时推荐，但也可作为防漂移选项使用。

entries.Original:
Will use both options from above.
This WILL give you down-time.
NOT recommended, but can be the answer if neither of the above options work for you.
entries.Translated:
将同时使用上述两个选项。
这会导致你出现空闲时间。
不推荐，但如果以上选项均不适用于你，这可能是答案。

entries.Original:
Will not use any anti-drift options.
This WILL cause drift. NOT recommended.
entries.Translated:
不使用任何防漂移选项。
这会导致漂移。不推荐。

entries.Original: This will check through your party members, and select the most desirable Partner, based on The Balance's priority list as well as stuff like Rez Sickness and Damage Downs.
entries.Translated: 这将检查你的队员，并根据 The Balance 的优先级列表以及复活虚弱和伤害降低等因素，选择最理想的舞伴。

entries.Original: NO SUPPORT is provided for setting up this feature!
entries.Translated: 不提供任何关于设置此功能的支持！

entries.Original:
You can change the respective actions by inputting action IDs below for each dance step.
The defaults are Cascade, Flourish, Fan Dance, and Fan Dance II.
If set to 0, they will reset to these actions.
(You can get Action IDs with Garland Tools by searching for the action and clicking the cog.)
entries.Translated:
你可以通过在下方为每个舞步输入技能 ID 来更改对应的技能。
默认技能为倾泻、百花争艳、扇舞·序和扇舞·破。
若设为 0，则会重置为这些技能。
（你可以在 Garland Tools 中搜索技能并点击齿轮图标来获取技能 ID。）

entries.Original: This WILL let you set up a conflict!
Double check the actions you are setting do not conflict with other combos you are using, or enable the feature below!
entries.Translated: 请仔细检查你设置的技能是否与你正在使用的其他连招冲突，否则请启用下方功能！

entries.Original: Select what kind of content to use this opener in:
entries.Translated: 选择在何种内容中使用此起手：

entries.Original:
Requires at least a 15s cooldown
and that you start Standard Step at 15s.
entries.Translated:
需要至少 15 秒的冷却时间，
并且你在 15 秒时开始标准舞步。

entries.Original:
Requires at least a 7s cooldown
and that you start Standard Step at 7s.
Performs worse than 15s.
entries.Translated:
需要至少 7 秒的冷却时间，
并且你在 7 秒时开始标准舞步。
表现不如 15 秒。

entries.Original:
Requires a 30s cooldown
and that you start Standard Step at 30s.
Not generally recommended.
Will align buffs worse than Standard 15s.
Not recommended if Standard Step would pull.
entries.Translated:
需要 30 秒的冷却时间，
并且你在 30 秒时开始标准舞步。
通常不推荐。
增益对齐效果不如标准 15 秒。
若标准舞步会开怪则不推荐。

entries.Original:
Requires at least a 7s cooldown.
Does NOT contain Standard Step.
Not generally recommended.
entries.Translated:
需要至少 7 秒的冷却时间。
不包含标准舞步。
通常不推荐。
技巧：7 秒倒计时（备选）

entries.Original: If you have a focus target that is within range, it will be prioritized over The Balance's suggested Dance Partner.
entries.Translated: 如果你有处于范围内的焦点目标，它将优先于 The Balance 建议的舞伴。

entries.Original: If you have a focus target that is within range, alive, and has no rez sickness or damage down, it will be prioritized over The Balance's suggested Dance Partner.
entries.Translated: 如果你有处于范围内、存活且没有复活虚弱或伤害降低的焦点目标，它将优先于 The Balance 建议的舞伴。

entries.Original: Target HP% to stop using Standard Step below
entries.Translated: 目标 HP% 低于此值时停止使用标准舞步

entries.Original:
Will include Standard Step itself,
dance steps, and Finish into the rotation.
entries.Translated:
会将标准舞步本身、
舞步以及结束技纳入循环。

entries.Original:
Will ONLY include the dance steps, and Finish;
YOU will need to manually press Standard Step.
entries.Translated:
仅包含舞步和结束动作；
你需要手动按下标准舞步。

entries.Original: Target HP% to stop using Technical Step below
entries.Translated: 低于此目标血量百分比时停止使用技巧舞步

entries.Original:
Will include Technical Step itself,
dance steps, and Finish into the rotation.
entries.Translated:
将技巧舞步本身、
舞步和结束动作纳入循环。

entries.Original:
Will ONLY include the dance Steps, and Finish;
YOU will need to manually press Technical Step.
entries.Translated:
仅包含舞步和结束动作；
你需要手动按下技巧舞步。

entries.Original: Target HP% to dump all pooled feathers below
entries.Translated: 低于此目标血量百分比时倾泻所有储存的幻扇

entries.Original:
Will use Tillana as recommended by The Balance.
Can allow Tillana to drift out of burst windows.
entries.Translated:
按太阳神之衡的建议使用提拉纳。
可能导致提拉纳偏离爆发窗口。

entries.Original:
Will use Tillana as recommended by The Balance,
but will also use it if about to expire.
Not really recommended.
entries.Translated:
按太阳神之衡的建议使用提拉纳，
但即将过期时也会使用。
不太推荐。

entries.Original:
Will perform Tillana over Saber or Dance of the Dawn, even if above 50 Esprit.
Can prevent Tillana from drifting out of burst windows.
Should be used with Saber Dance's Esprit slider being >50.
NOT recommended. Only for Esprit-Micro-Managers.
entries.Translated:
即使幻扇高于50也会优先使用提拉纳而非剑舞或拂晓舞。
可防止提拉纳偏离爆发窗口。
应与剑舞的幻扇滑块设为>50配合使用。
不推荐。仅适合幻扇微操管理者。
治疗之华尔兹血量百分比

entries.Original:
Will ONLY include the dance steps, and Finish;
YOU will need to manually press Technical Step.
entries.Translated:
仅包含舞步和结束动作；
你需要手动按下技巧舞步。

entries.Original: Action to Show when Partner is Optimal Options:     (hover each for more info)
entries.Translated: 舞伴最优时显示的动作 选项：（悬停查看详情）

entries.Original:
Will not change the action shown in the hotbar from what FFXIV puts there.
When you have a Dance Partner, it will show Ending, as usual.

This is the default behavior.
entries.Translated:
不会改变热键栏中FFXIV显示的动作。
当你拥有舞伴时，会照常显示结束动作。

这是默认行为。

entries.Original:
When your current partner is optimal Closed Position will be shown.
This will block you from using Closed Position or Ending
(unless you hard target a friendly other than your partner)
entries.Translated:
当你的当前舞伴处于最优状态时，将显示闭式舞姿。
这将阻止你使用闭式舞姿或结束
（除非你硬锁定一个非舞伴的友方目标）

entries.Original:
When your current partner is optimal, the input will be blocked.
This will block you from using Closed Position or Ending.

This is the recommended option, to keep you from mistakenly switching partners.
entries.Translated:
当你的当前舞伴处于最优状态时，将阻止输入。
这将阻止你使用闭式舞姿或结束。

这是推荐选项，可防止你误切换舞伴。

entries.Original: Enables the use of mitigations in Simple Mode.
entries.Translated: 在简单模式下启用减伤。

entries.Original: Disables the use of mitigations in Simple Mode.
entries.Translated: 在简单模式下禁用减伤。

entries.Original: Enables the use of advanced mitigations
Disables the use of advanced mitigations
Disables the use of advanced mitigations
HP% to use at or below
entries.Translated: HP% 使用阈值（低于或等于）

entries.Original: Select what difficulties TBN should be used on CD:
entries.Translated: 选择 TBN 应在 CD 上使用的难度：
优先使用暗影墙/暗影卫
在铁壁之前使用暗影墙/暗影卫

entries.Original:
Tries to align Dark Mind with Rampart for tankbusters.
(as it is lesser than Shadow Wall/Shadowed Vigil)
entries.Translated:
尝试将弃明投暗与铁壁对齐用于坦克buster。
（因为它弱于暗影墙/暗影卫）

entries.Original: Front-loads burst to align with an early (1st GCD) party buff window.
entries.Translated: 前置爆发以对齐早期（第1个GCD）的团队增益窗口。

entries.Original:
Will use Unmend to pull, if selected.
Should start at -1.0 seconds.

Recommended by The Balance.
entries.Translated:
如果选中，将使用伤残开怪。
应在 -1.0 秒时开始。

太阳神之衡推荐。

entries.Original:
Will use Shadowstride to pull, if selected.
Should start at -0.7 seconds.
entries.Translated:
如果选中，将使用暗影步开怪。
应在 -0.7 秒时开始。

entries.Original:
Will use Hard Slash to pull, if selected.
Should start at 0.0 seconds.
entries.Translated:
如果选中，将使用重斩开怪。
应在 0.0 秒时开始。

entries.Original: Will use Cooldowns regardless of the type of enemy.
entries.Translated: 无论敌人类型如何，都会使用能力技。

entries.Original:
Will try to use Cooldowns only when you're in a boss fight.
(Note: don't rely on this 100%, square sometimes marks enemies inconsistently)
entries.Translated:
仅在首领战中尝试使用能力技。
（注意：不要完全依赖此选项，Square 有时会不一致地标记敌人）

entries.Original: Select what difficulty the above sliders should apply to:
entries.Translated: 选择上述滑块适用的难度：

entries.Original: Will use Delirium usages on cooldown. Recommended.
entries.Translated: 冷却好了就使用错乱剑。推荐。

entries.Original: Tie to Living Shadow (for manual control)
entries.Translated: 绑定掠影示现（用于手动控制）

entries.Original:
Will require Living Shadow to have been recently used before using even-minute Deliriums.
(Odd-minute Delirium usage will proceed on cooldown)

ONLY recommended if you want more manual control.
(Does not apply to Blood Weapon)
entries.Translated:
在使用偶数分钟的错乱剑之前，需要最近使用过掠影示现。
（奇数分钟的错乱剑会按冷却正常使用）

仅当你想要更多手动控制时推荐。
（不适用于嗜血）

entries.Original:
Will use Salt and Darkness about halfway through Salted Earth's duration, after more important oGCDs.
Recommended.
entries.Translated:
在腐秽大地持续时间过半时使用腐秽黑暗，在更重要的能力技之后。
推荐。
立即使用（用于大量移动）

entries.Original:
Will use Salt and Darkness as soon as possible (outside of the opener).
Only Recommended for heavy movement fights, and only if you know you can fit your other oGCDs in.
entries.Translated:
尽快使用腐秽黑暗（起手式之外）。
仅推荐用于大量移动的战斗，且仅当你确定能塞下其他能力技时。

entries.Original: Mana to always save for TBN (0 = Use All). Spent freely until you have The Blackest Night.
entries.Translated: 为至黑之夜保留的魔力（0 = 全部使用）。在拥有至黑之夜前可自由消耗。

entries.Original: Seconds before Burst to save (allowing capping)
entries.Translated: 爆发前保留的秒数（允许溢出）

entries.Original: Will use Salt and Darkness as soon as possible.
Mana to save for TBN (0 = Use All). Spent freely until you have The Blackest Night.
entries.Translated: 为至黑之夜保留的魔力（0 = 全部使用）。在拥有至黑之夜前可自由消耗。

entries.Original: Select what difficulties Emergency Living Dead should be used in:
entries.Translated: 选择紧急行尸走肉应在哪些难度中使用：

entries.Original: Will not use Dark Missionary unless there are 2 or more party members.
entries.Translated: 除非有 2 名或以上小队成员，否则不会使用暗黑布道。

entries.Original: Will not require a party for Dark Missionary.
Will use Arm's Length regardless of the type of enemy.
entries.Translated: 无论敌人类型如何都会使用亲疏自行。

entries.Original: Will try not to use Arm's Length when in a boss fight.
entries.Translated: 在首领战中会尽量避免使用亲疏自行。

entries.Original: How many enemies should be nearby? (0 = No Requirement)
entries.Translated: 附近应有多少敌人？（0 = 无要求）
暗影墙 / 警戒优先级：

entries.Original:
Note: If you are Off-Tanking, and want to use this ability on yourself, the expectation would be that you do so via the One-Button Mitigation Feature or the Mitigation options in your rotation.
If you don't, it would go to the main tank.
If you don't use those Features for your personal mitigation, you may not want to enable this.
entries.Translated:
注意：如果你是副坦，并希望对自己使用此技能，预期应通过一键减伤功能或循环中的减伤选项来实现。
如果不这样做，它会作用于主坦。
如果你不使用这些功能进行个人减伤，可能不想启用此项。

entries.Original:
Time Remaining on Oblation to allow within
(0 = Oblation must not be on the target)
entries.Translated:
允许献奉剩余时间在
(0 = 目标身上不能有献奉)

entries.Original: Will use Camouflage as extra tankbuster mitigation if under this HP%
entries.Translated: 当 HP 低于此百分比时，将伪装作为额外的坦克buster减伤使用

entries.Original: Tries to align Camouflage with Rampart for tankbusters.
entries.Translated: 尝试将伪装与铁壁对齐以应对坦克buster。
在所有起手循环中正常使用

entries.Original: as soon as possible in all openers
entries.Translated: 在所有起手循环中尽快使用

entries.Original: for at least one usage inside of
entries.Translated: 以在以下期间至少使用一次

entries.Original: Does not hold any charges of

Stop usage if Target HP% is below set value.
 To disable this, set value to 0
entries.Translated:
目标HP%低于设定值时停止使用。
 要禁用此功能，请将值设为0

entries.Original: as the last GCD in burst
entries.Translated: 作为爆发中的最后一个GCD

entries.Original: Select what difficulties Superbolide should be used in:
entries.Translated: 选择超火流星应在哪些难度中使用：

entries.Original: Will not use Heart of Light unless there are 2 or more party members.
entries.Translated: 队伍中少于2名队员时不使用光之心。

entries.Original: Will not require a party for Heart of Light.
Uses cooldowns only when inside a weave window (excludes No Mercy)
entries.Translated: 仅在插入窗口内使用能力技（不含无情）

entries.Original: Uses cooldowns as soon as possible
entries.Translated: 能力技冷却好了就尽快使用

entries.Original: Use this feature as intended on
WARNING: This WILL conflict with 'No Mercy Features'!
entries.Translated: 警告：此设置会与“无情功能”冲突！

entries.Original: procs available as soon as possible

Dynamic choice of combo finisher based on position and available charges.
Go to Flank to build charges, Rear to spend them. 
Prevents overcap or waste and will use true north as needed.
entries.Translated:
根据位置和可用层数动态选择连击必杀。
前往侧身积攒层数，前往背面消耗层数。
防止溢出或浪费，并按需使用真北。

entries.Original: to use Kazematoi when target is below Health %
entries.Translated: 在目标生命值低于 % 时使用风缠

entries.Original: Stop using on targets below this HP % (0% = always use, 100% = never use).
entries.Translated: 停止对生命值低于此 % 的目标使用（0% = 始终使用，100% = 从不使用）。

entries.Original: Will Pool the charges, saving them for Trick Window
entries.Translated: 将留存层数，留待攻其不备窗口使用

entries.Original:
Will Use Raiton when out of Melee range of the target, 
This can negatively affect your burst windows
entries.Translated:
在目标近战范围外时使用雷遁，
这可能会对你的爆发窗口产生负面影响

entries.Original: Set the amount of time remaining on Trick Attack cooldown before trying to set up with Suiton.
entries.Translated: 设置攻其不备冷却剩余时间，以便尝试用水遁进行准备。

entries.Original: Will automatically Fuma Shuriken then Raiton then Suiton

resources.Original:

Egi abilities will appear on their respective Egi summon ability, as well as Titan.
resources.Translated:
召唤兽技能（星极超流）就绪时加入对应召唤兽召唤中。
召唤兽技能会显示在对应的召唤兽召唤技能上，泰坦亦然。

resources.Original: Replaces Windmill with a full one-button AoE rotation.
resources.Translated: 将风车替换为完整的一键群体循环。

resources.Original: Adds selected buffs to the rotation
resources.Translated: 将选定的增益加入循环

resources.Original: Enable this to add Summoner-specific actions into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 启用后将召唤师专属技能加入循环。

resources.Original:
Includes Improvisation in the AoE rotation when available.
Will not use while under Technical Finish
resources.Translated:
群体循环中即兴表演可用时加入。
技巧舞步结束期间不会使用

resources.Original: Adds Blast Arrow to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将爆破箭加入爆发模式。

resources.Original: Enable this to add Chemist-specific actions into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 启用后会将化学师专属技能加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds Howling Fist / Enlightenment to the rotation
resources.Translated: 将空鸣拳 / 星导山山顶加入循环
空鸣拳 / 星导山山顶选项

resources.Original: Adds Phalanx Combo to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将列阵连击加入爆发模式。
将重力替换为以下选项
高级输出模式 - 群体

resources.Original: Adds Orogeny into the AoE rotation.
resources.Translated: 将地面崩坏加入群体循环。
使用均衡来施放均衡失衡。

resources.Original: Weaves Lucid Dreaming when your MP drops below the specified value.
resources.Translated: 当你的魔力低于指定值时插入醒梦。

resources.Original:
Changes Magick Barrier to Addle when on cooldown. 
Will Display the lowest cooldown skill if both are on cooldown.
resources.Translated:
当抗死处于冷却时改为使用混乱。
若两者都在冷却中，则显示冷却最短的技能。

resources.Original: Adds Feint when Raidwide is detected casting and not in a Mudra.
resources.Translated: 检测到全屏攻击读条且不在忍术状态时加入牵制。

resources.Original: Adds Role Action Smite to Burst Mode below selected health
resources.Translated: 在低于所选血量时，将职能技能重击加入爆发模式

resources.Original: Adds Occult Cure III into the rotation.
Adds Blizzard in Cyan to the combo.
resources.Translated: 将冰结之蓝青加入连击。

resources.Original: Retargets Benefic and Benefic II to the heal stack (even from the Benefic 2 Downgrade Feature above).
resources.Translated: 将吉星和吉星II的目标重新指向治疗堆叠（即使来自上方的吉星2降级功能）。

resources.Original:
Adds (Executioner's) Gibbet and Gallows on Blood Stalk.
Adds (Executioner's) Guillotine on Grim Swathe.
resources.Translated:
在隐匿挥割后加入（绞决）处刑和缢杀。
在束缚挥割后加入（断首）处刑。

resources.Original: Gibbet and Gallows/Guillotine on Blood Stalk/Grim Swathe Feature
resources.Translated: 隐匿挥割/束缚挥割后的处刑和缢杀/断首功能

resources.Original: Includes Finishing Move in the rotation.
Adds Primal Wrath into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将原初的怒震加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds The Blackest Night when below HP threshold and targeted.
resources.Translated: 当血量低于阈值且已选中目标时，加入至黑之夜。

resources.Original: Adds missing Motifs to the combo while out of combat.
resources.Translated: 在战斗外为连击补充缺失的动机。

resources.Original:
Add Corps-a-corps when available for DPS. 
Will retain a charge for gap-closing.
resources.Translated:
在可用时加入短兵相接以提升输出。
会保留一层充能用于突进。

resources.Original: Uses Edge of Darkness if you are at or above 9,400 mana, except when saving for burst.
resources.Translated: 当魔力达到或超过 9,400 时使用暗黑锋，但为爆发预留时除外。

resources.Original:
Includes Devilment in the rotation.
Will activate only during Technical Finish if you're Lv70 or above.
Will be used on cooldown below Lv70.
resources.Translated:
将进攻之探戈纳入循环。
若你达到 70 级或以上，仅在技巧舞步结束期间启动。
70 级以下则冷却好了就用。

resources.Original: Collection of spenders (mana and blood) to add to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 加入循环的消耗技能集合（魔力与暗血）。

resources.Original: Retargets Asylum to yourself (even from the Mitigation Feature above).
resources.Translated: 将庇护所重新指向自己（即使来自上方的减伤功能）。

resources.Original: Turns Dual Fang Combo into an all-in-one button.
resources.Translated: 将双牙连击变为一键整合按钮。
在可用时使用失传推进。
将死星核爆加入爆发模式。

resources.Original:
Adds Ikishoten when at or below 50 Kenki.
PRE 94: Will dump Kenki at 10 seconds left to allow Ikishoten to be used.
POST 94: Will use during burst window.
resources.Translated:
当剑气值小于等于50时使用意气冲天。
94级前：在剩余10秒时倾泻剑气，以便使用意气冲天。
94级后：在爆发窗口内使用。

resources.Original:
Changes Asylum into Temperance and then Divine Caress after use.
Can be Retargeted with the Retargeting Features below.
resources.Translated:
使用后将会把庇护所变为节制，随后变为神爱抚。
可通过下方的重新选目标功能重新选目标。

resources.Original: Weaves Druochole when Addersgall gauge is greater than or equal to the specified value.
resources.Translated: 当蛇胆量规大于等于指定值时插入灵橡清汁。

resources.Original:
Adds the Atonement chain to Advanced Mode.
- Will be prioritized if buff is expiring.
resources.Translated:
将赎罪剑连击加入高级模式。
- 若增益即将结束时将优先使用。
加入泰然自若用于治疗。

resources.Original: Blizzard I to Blizzard IV Feature
Replaces Blizzard I with Blizzard IV when available.
resources.Translated: 当可用时将冰结I替换为冰结IV。

resources.Original: Changes Swiftcast to Verraise when under the effect of Swiftcast or Dualcast.
resources.Translated: 当处于即刻咏唱或连续咏唱效果下时，将即刻咏唱变为赤复活。

resources.Original:
Replaces True Thrust with a full one-button single target rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
resources.Translated:
将精准刺替换为完整的单键单体循环。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。
当可用时使用失传护盾。

resources.Original: Adds Leg Sweep when target non-boss is casting.
resources.Translated: 当非首领目标正在咏唱时使用扫堂枪。

resources.Original: Adds Occult Raise into the rotation, retargeted to your Raise Stack.
resources.Translated: 将魔复活加入循环，目标改为你的复活层数。

resources.Original: Adds Fated Brand into the AoE rotation when available.
resources.Translated: 当可用时，将命运之印加入AoE循环。

resources.Original: Replace Prominence with its combo chain.
resources.Translated: 将日珥斩替换为其连击链。

resources.Original:
Casts Searing Light only during Demi phases.
Spellspeed builds would turn this off.
resources.Translated:
仅在亚灵神阶段施放灼热之光。
咏速配装建议关闭此项。

resources.Original: Change Standard Step into each dance step, while dancing.
resources.Translated: 跳舞期间将标准舞步替换为各个舞步。

resources.Original: Adds Bloodbath and Second Wind to the combo, using them when below the HP Percentage threshold.
resources.Translated: 将浴血和内丹加入连击，在生命值百分比低于阈值时使用。

resources.Original: Retains 1 Lightspeed charge for manual use
resources.Translated: 保留1层光速充能供手动使用
在冷却就绪时加入已装备的蛮神技能。

resources.Original: Adds Rampart to the one-button mitigation.
Retargets Shirk to the other tank if there is one.
resources.Translated: 如果有另一个坦克，将退避的目标改为该坦克。

resources.Original: Adds Quietus to the rotation when under Delirium, or just after Burst.
resources.Translated: 在错乱剑状态下或爆发后立即将寂灭加入循环。

resources.Original:
Uses Zantetsuken when available.
- Will not use if target is invulnerable.
- Requires target to have player's Kuzushi.
resources.Translated:
可用时使用斩铁剑。
- 目标无敌时不使用。
- 需要目标带有自己的崩破。

resources.Original:
Replaces Doomspike with a full one-button AoE rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
resources.Translated:
将死之突进替换为完整的一键AoE循环。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。

resources.Original: Adds Bloodbath and Second Wind to the combo, using them when below the HP Percentage threshold.
resources.Translated: 将浴血和内丹加入连击，在生命值百分比低于阈值时使用。

resources.Original: Replace Hissatsu: Kyuten with Zanshin when usable.
resources.Translated: 可用时将必杀：九天替换为残心。

resources.Original: Saves high-damaging actions until the target's HP falls below the threshold.
resources.Translated: 将高伤害技能保留至目标HP低于阈值时使用。
将即刻咏唱替换为复活。

resources.Original: Weaves Rhizomata when Addersgall gauge falls below the specified value.
resources.Translated: 当蛇胆汁量表低于指定值时插入根素。

resources.Original: Triggers Pepsis if a shield is present.
resources.Translated: 若存在护盾则触发消化。

resources.Original:
Uses Forte when available.
- Will not use outside combat.
- Requires player's HP to be under:
resources.Translated:
可用时使用强音。
- 战斗外不使用。
- 需要自身HP低于：

resources.Original:
Replaces Heavy Swing with a full one-button single target rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
resources.Translated:
将重劈替换为完整的单键单体循环。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。

resources.Original: Adds Curing Waltz to the combo when available, and your HP is at or below the set percentage.
resources.Translated: 当技能可用且你的HP低于或等于设定百分比时，将治疗之华尔兹加入连击。

resources.Original: Retargets Kardia according to your Healing stack (even from the Soteria to Kardia Feature above)
resources.Translated: 根据你的治疗量层数重新指定心关目标（包括上方从拯救到心关的功能）

resources.Original:
Adds the Balance opener at level 70/80/90/100.
Prepull:
- Meikyo at -13
- True North at -5 (skipped if target has no positionals)
- Gekko on pull
Without a countdown, prepull steps have no delay.
(During a countdown only: blocks action until each prepull timing)
resources.Translated:
在70/80/90/100级时加入太阳神之衡起手。
预拉：
- 明镜止水于-13
- 真北于-5（若目标无身位则跳过）
- 拉怪时使用月光
无倒计时时，预拉步骤无延迟。
（仅在倒计时期间：阻止动作直到每个预拉时机）

resources.Original: Adds Holy Spellblade into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将魔法剑·神圣加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds the Balance opener from level 92 onwards.
resources.Translated: 从92级起加入太阳神之衡起手。

resources.Original: Retargets Earthly Star to the the ground Under yourself.
resources.Translated: 将地星重新指定到你脚下的地面。

resources.Original: Includes Flourish in the AoE rotation.
resources.Translated: 在群体循环中加入百花争艳。
简单治疗模式 - 单体

resources.Original:
Replaces Diagnosis with a full one-button single target healing utility.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job. Particularly with autorotation.
resources.Translated:
将诊断替换为完整的一键单体治疗工具。
这是该职业新手的理想选择，尤其是配合自动循环时。

resources.Original: Enables the use of dot sub options below
resources.Translated: 启用下方的持续伤害子选项
吟游诗人持续伤害选项

resources.Original: Adds The Blackest Night when an incoming tankbuster is detected.
resources.Translated: 检测到即将到来的坦克杀手时添加至黑之夜。
至黑之夜坦克杀手选项

resources.Original: Retargets Lustrate according to your Healing stack.
resources.Translated: 根据你的治疗量堆叠重新指定生命活性法的目标。

resources.Original: Adds Dragonfire Dive to the rotation.
Adds Interject to the rotation when your target's cast is interruptible.
resources.Translated: 当目标咏唱可打断时，将插言加入循环。

resources.Original: Replace Hissatsu: Shinten with Senei when off cooldown.
resources.Translated: 冷却结束时将必杀剑：震天替换为闪影。

resources.Original: Adds Berserk / Inner Release into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将狂暴 / 原初的解放加入循环。

resources.Original:
Options for Advanced Combos' In-Combo Mitigation.
Enable Mitigation in each Advanced Combo to use these options.
(Simple Mode does not use these Options, instead Recommended Values in place of them)
resources.Translated:
高级连击的连击中减伤选项。
在每个高级连击中启用减伤以使用这些选项。
（简单模式不使用这些选项，而是使用推荐值代替）
疾风/毒菌持续时间选项

resources.Original: Adds Aero/Dia to the single target combo if the debuff is not present on current target, or is about to expire.
resources.Translated: 如果当前目标没有该减益效果，或即将消失，则将疾风/毒菌加入单体连击。

resources.Original: Uses Rattling Coil when any condition is met.
resources.Translated: 满足任意条件时使用飞蛇之魂。

resources.Original: Turns Heavy Swing into an all-in-one damage button.
resources.Translated: 将重劈变为一键式综合输出按钮。

resources.Original: Add openers into the rotation based on Skill Speed and current Level, starting at Lv90.
resources.Translated: 根据技能速度和当前等级将起手式加入循环，从90级开始。

resources.Original: Changes Deep Clean to Peat Pelt if current target is not inflicted with Begrimed.
resources.Translated: 若当前目标未陷入泥污状态，则将大扫除变为玩泥球。

resources.Original:
Replaces Sonic Boom with a full one-button single target rotation.
Also used with Healer Mimicry when the party does not need healing.
resources.Translated:
将音爆替换为完整的一键式单体循环。
当队伍无需治疗时也用于治疗者模仿。

resources.Original: Adds Stellar Detonation when under the effect of Giant Dominance.
resources.Translated: 在巨星主宰效果下加入星体爆轰。

resources.Original:
Collection of cheeky or encounter-specific extra options only available to those in the know.
Do not expect these options to be maintained, or even kept, after they are no longer Current.
resources.Translated:
仅供内行人士使用的趣味或特定副本额外选项合集。
不要期望这些选项在不再流行后仍会维护，甚至保留。

resources.Original:
Replaces True Thrust with a full one-button single target rotation.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
将精准刺替换为完整的一键式单体循环。
这是新手入门的理想选项。

resources.Original: Changes Holos into Eukrasion Prognosis to apply shields.
resources.Translated: 将坚壁之策变为预后以施加护盾。

resources.Original: Adds Paradox as a filler at max level to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 满级时在循环中加入悖论作为填充技能。

resources.Original: Will reapply DoT early to all enemies within range while moving.
resources.Translated: 移动时提前对范围内所有敌人重新施加持续伤害。

resources.Original: Adds Bloodfest into the AoE rotation when appropriate.
resources.Translated: 在合适时机将血壤加入群体循环。

resources.Original:
Replaces Bootshine with a full one-button single target rotation.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
将连击替换为完整的单键单体循环。
这是新手入门的理想选项。

resources.Original: Retains 1 Lightspeed charge for manual use
resources.Translated: 保留1层光速充能供手动使用

resources.Original: Adds Flame Scroll into the rotation when the target has Fire Weakness.
resources.Translated: 当目标带有看穿弱点：火时，将火遁之术加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds Tenri Jindo to Advanced Mode.
resources.Translated: 将天理人道加入高级模式。

resources.Original:
Replaces Holy with a full one-button AoE rotation. 
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
将神圣替换为完整的单键群体循环。
这是新手入门的理想选项。
简易输出模式 - 群体

resources.Original: Adds Shade Shift to Advanced Mode.

If your target's target is not you, will Retarget Nascent Flash onto them.
(if you're not top aggro, and not mousing over or hard targeting an ally)
resources.Translated:
如果你的目标的当前目标不是你，会将原初的勇猛重新选定目标到其身上。
（如果你不是最高仇恨，且没有鼠标悬停或硬选定一名队友）

resources.Original: Use Energy Drain to consume remaining Aetherflow stacks when Aetherflow is about to come off cooldown.
resources.Translated: 当以太超流即将冷却完毕时，使用能量吸收消耗剩余的以太超流层数。

resources.Original: Adds Superbolide when 5 or more targets as part of the mitigation rotation. (Recommended)
resources.Translated: 当目标数量达到5个或以上时，作为减伤循环的一部分加入超火流星。（推荐）
对多个目标维持持续伤害。

resources.Original: Includes Closed Position when out of combat and no dance partner is found.
resources.Translated: 在脱战且未找到舞伴时加入闭式舞姿。

resources.Original: Adds selected oGCD abilities to Carve And Spit and Abyssal Drain.
resources.Translated: 将选定的能力技加入精雕怒斩和吸血深渊。

resources.Original:
Gauss Round / Ricochet 
Double Check / Checkmate option
resources.Translated:
虹吸弹 / 弹射
双将 / 将死 选项

resources.Original: Adds Gauss Round and Ricochet or Double Check and Checkmate to the rotation. Will prevent overcapping.
resources.Translated: 将虹吸弹和弹射或双将和将死加入循环。可防止溢出。

resources.Original: Adds Role Action Diabrosis to Burst Mode below selected health
resources.Translated: 在低于选定生命值时将职能技能溃破加入爆发模式

resources.Original:
Adds Shield Bash to the rotation when your target is casting.
Not advised outside of overworld content, as it can waste a lot of GCDs on un-stun-able enemies, etc. Will try to not use it in boss fights.
resources.Translated:
当目标正在咏唱时将盾牌猛击加入循环。
不建议在野外内容之外使用，因为它可能会在无法眩晕的敌人等身上浪费大量GCD。会尽量避免在Boss战中使用。
使用盾牌猛击打断选项

resources.Original:
Adds Bulwark to the one-button mitigation.
NOTE: even if disabled, will still try to use Bulwark as the lowest priority.
resources.Translated:
将壁垒加入一键减伤。
注意：即使禁用，仍会尝试将壁垒作为最低优先级使用。

resources.Original:
Add Corps-a-corps when available for DPS. 
Will retain a charge for gap-closing.
resources.Translated:
在可用时加入短兵相接以提升输出。
会保留一层充能用于突进。

resources.Original: Replace Reaving Fangs with its combo chain.
resources.Translated: 将穿裂尖齿替换为其连击链。

resources.Original: Adds Cure 2/3 and Aquaveil to Burst combo below all damage options.
resources.Translated: 在所有伤害选项下方，将治疗2/3和水流幕加入爆发连招。

resources.Original:
Adds Grim Reaping to the rotation.
(Disabling this may stop the one-button combo working during enshroud)
resources.Translated:
将阴冷收割加入循环。
（禁用此项可能导致一键连招在夜游魂衣期间失效）

resources.Original: Replaces basic combo with Death Rattle or Last Lash when applicable.
resources.Translated: 在适用时用蛇尾击或蛇尾闪替换基础连招。

resources.Original:
Uses Corps-a-corps when available.
- Must remain within maximum range.
- Requires Enchanted Riposte to be available.
resources.Translated:
在可用时使用短兵相接。
- 必须保持在最大距离内。
- 需要魔回刺可用。

resources.Original: s, wait to Hypercharge until Tool cooldowns are at least this value
resources.Translated: 秒，等待超荷直到工具冷却至少达到此值

resources.Original: Replaces Scathe with Xenoglossy when available.
resources.Translated: 在可用时用异言替换灼烧。

resources.Original:
Replaces Demon Slice with a full one-button AoE rotation.
This feature is ideal for any fresh newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
用完整的一键AoE循环替换恶魔切。
此功能非常适合该职业的新手。

resources.Original: Adds Leg Sweep when target non-boss is casting.
resources.Translated: 当非首领目标正在咏唱时使用扫堂枪。

resources.Original: Adds True North when under Gluttony and if Gibbet/Gallows options are selected to replace those skills.
resources.Translated: 在暴食状态下且选择了绞刑/缢杀选项替换这些技能时，加入真北。

resources.Original: Uses Guard when your HP is under the set threshold.
resources.Translated: 当你的HP低于设定阈值时使用防御。

resources.Original: Replace Clean Shot with its combo chain.
resources.Translated: 用其连招链替换狙击弹。

resources.Original: Adds Oka combo to the rotation.
Adds Interject into the rotation when your target's cast is interruptible.
resources.Translated: 当目标咏唱可打断时，将插言加入循环。

resources.Original:
Adds Riposte to start the combo. Recommended for Auto Rotation. 
**Must be in melee range or have gap-close with Corps-a-corps enabled**
resources.Translated:
加入回刺以开始连招。推荐用于自动循环。
**必须处于近战范围，或启用短兵相接进行突进**

resources.Original:
Replaces Pom Cure with a full one-button single target healing utility.
Pair with DPS Mode to damage when the party is healthy.
resources.Translated:
将绒绒治疗替换为完整的一键单体治疗工具。
搭配输出模式可在队伍血量健康时进行输出。

resources.Original: Adds Presence of Mind to the AoE combo
resources.Translated: 将神速咏唱加入群体输出循环

resources.Original:
Adds Shinten to the rotation.
Will pool kenki for burst.
resources.Translated:
将震天加入循环。
会积攒剑气用于爆发。

resources.Original: Replaces Storm's Path with Storm's Eye when Surging Tempest buff needs refreshing.
resources.Translated: 当战场风暴增益需要刷新时，将暴风斩替换为暴风碎。

resources.Original: Replaces Snagging with Salvage when diving.
resources.Translated: 潜水时将钓组替换为打捞。

resources.Original: Weaves Soteria if you have the Kardia buff.
resources.Translated: 当你拥有心关增益时插入拯救。

resources.Original: Adds Radiant Aegis to Burst Mode when available, and your HP is at or below the set percentage.
resources.Translated: 当守护之光可用且你的体力低于或等于设定百分比时，将其加入爆发模式。

resources.Original: Replaces Bulwark with an all-in-one mitigation button.
resources.Translated: 将壁垒替换为全能一键减伤按钮。

resources.Original:
Replaces Scatter with a full one-button AoE rotation.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
To start the melee combo, you must be within melee range.
resources.Translated:
将散碎替换为完整的一键群体循环。
这是新手职业的理想选择。
要开始近战连击，你必须处于近战范围内。

resources.Original: Adds the Balance opener from level 92 onwards.
resources.Translated: 从92级起加入太阳神之衡起手。

resources.Original: Adds Occult Thunder III into the rotation (prefers Lightning Weakness).
resources.Translated: 将魔暴雷加入循环（优先看穿弱点：雷）。
高级输出模式 - 单体目标

resources.Original: Adds various options to Dosis I/II/III.
resources.Translated: 为毒菌 I/II/III 添加各种选项。

resources.Original: Replaces Avalanche Axe, Mistral Axe, Spinning Axe and Gale Axe with Trick when it's ready. Locks out the actions if Trick is the wrong affinity or until ready to complete an Instinctual Combo. Order of actions prioritises getting to 2 Mastered Instinct stacks and 1 Natural Instinct stack.
resources.Translated: 当诡计就绪时，用其替换山崩斧、寒风斧、回旋斧和风啸斧。如果诡计的属性不符或未准备好完成本能连击，则锁定这些技能。技能顺序优先获得 2 层精通本能和 1 层自然本能。

resources.Original:
Adds Aurora when 3 or more targets. 
- NOTE: This feature will overlap with other mitigations.
resources.Translated:
当目标为 3 个或以上时使用极光。
- 注意：此功能会与其他减伤重叠。

resources.Original: Adds Uncoiled Twinfang and Uncoiled Twinblood to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将飞蛇连尾击和飞蛇乱尾击加入循环。

resources.Original:
Replaces Quick Nock with a full one-button AoE rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
resources.Translated:
用完整的单键 AoE 循环替换连珠箭。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。

resources.Original: Includes Last Dance in the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将最后的舞步加入循环。

resources.Original: Replaces the combo chain with Harpe when outside of melee range. Will not override Communio.
resources.Translated: 在近战范围外时用哈耳庇厄替换连击链。不会覆盖团契。

resources.Original: Adds Comet in Black to the combo.
Will spend Dark Arts if your own The Blackest Night shield is active on you, except when saving for burst.
resources.Translated: 如果你自身的至黑之夜护盾处于激活状态，将消耗暗技，但在为爆发保留时除外。

resources.Original: Uses Analysis with Air Anchor instead of Chain Saw.
resources.Translated: 使用分析配合空气锚而非回转飞锯。

resources.Original: Adds Barrel Stabilizer to the feature when off cooldown.
resources.Translated: 技能冷却结束时自动加入枪管加热。

resources.Original: Use Banner of Noble Ends only when under Lost Font of Power.
resources.Translated: 仅在失传力泉状态下使用背水境地。

resources.Original: Adds Occult Cure II into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将秘术治疗 II 加入循环。

resources.Original: Weave Sidewinder, Empyreal arrow, Bloodletter, and Pitch perfect when available.
resources.Translated: 在可用时插入侧风诱导箭、九天连箭、失血箭和完美音调。

resources.Original:
Replaces Spreadshot with a full one-button AoE rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
Will lock out input to keep Flamethrower going.
resources.Translated:
将散射替换为完整的一键 AoE 循环。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。
将锁定输入以维持火焰喷射器。

resources.Original: Replaces Cast with Gig when diving.
resources.Translated: 潜水时将抛竿替换为鱼叉。

resources.Original: Will Retarget the Raise affected here to your Heal Stack.
resources.Translated: 将此处受影响的复活重新指定给你的治疗小队。

resources.Original: Replaces Unleash with a full one-button AoE rotation.
resources.Translated: 将释放替换为完整的一键 AoE 循环。

resources.Original: Replaces Blizzard IV with Despair when in Astral Fire.
resources.Translated: 在星极火状态下将冰结 IV 替换为绝望。
冰结 IV 替换为绝望

resources.Original: Turns Drakesbane Combo into an all-in-one damage button.
resources.Translated: 将云蒸龙变连击变为一键伤害按钮。

resources.Original:
Replaces Steel Maw with a full one-button AoE rotation.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
将咬噬尖牙替换为完整的一键 AoE 循环。
这是新手入门的理想选项。
高级治疗模式 - 群体

resources.Original: Will Heal Lowest Health Party member until you fall below set threshold
resources.Translated: 将治疗血量最低的队伍成员，直到你低于设定阈值

resources.Original: Diagnosis becomes Eukrasian Diagnosis if the shield is not applied to the target.
resources.Translated: 若目标未获得护盾，则诊断变为均衡诊断。

resources.Original: Adds Combust to the DPS feature if it's not present on current target, or is about to expire.
resources.Translated: 若当前目标未带有烧灼或即将到期，则将烧灼加入输出功能。

resources.Original: Use Banner of Tireless Conviction when available.

Replaces Ruin I / Broils with a full one-button single target rotation.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
将毁坏 I / 炽炎替换为完整的一键单体循环。
这是新手职业的理想选项。
简易输出模式 - 单体

resources.Original: Retargets Physick according to your Healing stack.
resources.Translated: 根据你的治疗层数重新指定医术目标。
在扇舞·终前加入扇舞·序。

resources.Original: Allows for a custom priority and selection of mudras when under the Three Mudra effect.
resources.Translated: 在三印自在效果下允许自定义优先级和印的选择。

resources.Original:
Adds Soulsow to the skills selected below when out of combat. 
Will also add Soulsow to Harpe when in combat and no target is selected.
resources.Translated:
脱战时将播魂种加入下方选择的技能中。
战斗中且未选择目标时，也会将播魂种加入哈耳庇厄。

resources.Original: Adds Serpents Ire to the rotation.
Allows you to cancel your guard with Recuperate on the Guard button if health is low enough to not waste it.
resources.Translated: 当生命值足够低、不会浪费时，允许你在防御按钮上用自愈取消防御。

resources.Original: Adds UI mouseover to the priority. Above LowHP option.
resources.Translated: 将UI鼠标指向加入优先级。位于低生命值选项之上。
鼠标指向深仁厚泽选项

resources.Original: Adds Interject to the AoE rotation when your target's cast is interruptible.
resources.Translated: 当目标施法可打断时，将插言加入范围循环。

resources.Original: Adds Occult Counter into the rotation.
Turns Song of Torment into Bristle so Song of Torment is buffed.
resources.Translated: 将苦闷之歌变为怒发冲冠，使苦闷之歌获得增益。

resources.Original: Turns Ten Chi Jin (the move) into Ten, Chi, and Jin.
resources.Translated: 将天地人（技能）拆分为天、地、人。

resources.Original: Eukrasia turns into the selected Eukrasian-type action when active.
resources.Translated: 均衡激活时变为所选的均衡类技能。

resources.Original:
Adds Communio onto the main combo when you have 1 stack of Enshroud remaining.
Will not trigger if you are moving.
resources.Translated:
当剩余1层夜游魂衣时，将团契加入主连击。
移动时不会触发。

resources.Original: Replaces Fire I or Fire III with the options below.
resources.Translated: 用以下选项替换火炎或爆炎。

resources.Original:
Uses Soten when available.
- Must remain within maximum range.
- Will not use if already under Kaiten's effect.
resources.Translated:
双天可用时使用。
- 必须保持在最大距离内。
- 已处于回天效果下时不会使用。
扇舞·序 -> 扇舞·终 选项

resources.Original: Changes Fan Dance 1 to Fan Dance 3 when available.
resources.Translated: 扇舞·终可用时，将扇舞·序替换为扇舞·终。

resources.Original: Adds Shake It Off to the one-button mitigation.
Add Selected Motifs to the combo.
resources.Translated: 将选中的绘灵加入连击。

resources.Original: Adds High Jump to Burst Mode.

resources.Translated: 冷却好了就使用多变铁壁。

resources.Original: Adds Living Shadow to the Feature.
Adds Nebula/Great Nebula when 3 or more targets.
resources.Translated: 目标为3个或以上时加入星云/大星云。

resources.Original: Uses Head Graze to interrupt during the rotation, where applicable.
resources.Translated: 在循环中适时使用伤头击进行打断。

resources.Original: Replace Stalwart Soul with its combo chain.
Adds the songs to the oGCD feature. Wanderers > Mages > Armys
resources.Translated: 将歌曲加入oGCD功能。放浪神 > 贤者 > 军神

resources.Original:
Adds Requiescat to Advanced Mode.
- Uses after Fight or Flight.
resources.Translated:
将安魂祈祷加入高级模式。
- 在战逃反应后使用。

resources.Original: Replace Hissatsu: Shinten with Zanshin when usable.
resources.Translated: 可用时将必杀剑：震天替换为残心。

resources.Original: Adds Lucid Dreaming when MP drops below slider value
resources.Translated: 当MP低于滑块数值时使用醒梦

resources.Original: Makes it incredibly difficult to rabbit your jutsus. May cause clipping if latency is bad.
resources.Translated: 使你的忍术极难变成兔子。延迟高时可能导致卡顿。

resources.Original: Applies Esuna to your target if there is a cleansable debuff.
resources.Translated: 若目标身上有可解除的减益，则对其施放康复。

resources.Original: Adds Kardia when not under the effect.
resources.Translated: 未处于效果下时加入心关。

resources.Original: Adds Subtractive Palette to the combo.
Will lock out Arm's Length in boss encounters when you already have knockback immunity from Inner Release.
resources.Translated: 当已通过原初的解放获得击退免疫时，在首领战中锁定亲疏自行。

resources.Original: Adds Horrid Roar to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将恐惧咆哮加入爆发模式。

resources.Original: Changes Fan Dance 1 to Fan Dance 4 when available.
resources.Translated: 当扇舞·四可用时，将扇舞·序替换为扇舞·四。

resources.Original: Adds Deadly Blow into the rotation.

resources.Translated: 在循环中加入义结金兰
所有能力技用于失血箭/心碎射击
仅将即刻咏唱用于移动。

resources.Original: Adds Sundering Spellblade into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将魔法剑·石化加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds Chain Saw to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将回转飞锯加入爆发模式。

resources.Original: Adds Heart of Corundum to Burst Mode under set health %.
resources.Translated: 在设定血量百分比以下时将刚玉之心加入爆发模式。

resources.Original: s, drift Wildfire over Tools if tools cooldowns are less than this value
resources.Translated: 秒，若工具冷却时间低于此值，则将野火延后至工具之后

resources.Original: Adds Biolysis use on cooldown to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将蛊毒法按冷却加入爆发模式。

resources.Original:
Will try to cast Succor when a raidwide casting is detected if shieldcheck from succor setting passes. 
Will be used in all 4 Advanced combos.
resources.Translated:
当检测到团队治疗施法且鼓舞的护盾检查设置通过时，将尝试施放鼓舞。
将用于全部 4 个高级连招。

resources.Original: Adds The Arrow (increased healing) when the card has been drawn.
resources.Translated: 抽到该卡牌时加入放浪神之箭（提高治疗量）。
扇舞·序 → 扇舞·破 选项

resources.Original: Adds Apex Arrow and Blast shot
resources.Translated: 加入绝峰箭和爆发射击

resources.Original: Changes Fan Dance 2 to Fan Dance 3 when available.
resources.Translated: 扇舞·序可用时改为扇舞·破。

resources.Original: Adds Raw Intuition/Bloodwhetting when available. Will overlap with others.
resources.Translated: 可用时加入原初的直觉/原初的血气。将与其他技能重叠。
原初的直觉/原初的血气选项

resources.Original: Adds Empyrean Potion to one button rotations
resources.Translated: 将天界药水加入一键循环
天佑女王 - 天界药水

resources.Original: Adds Rampart when 3 or more targets
All AoE oGCD's on Rain of Death depending on their CD.
resources.Translated: 根据冷却时间，将所有AoE能力技加入死亡箭雨。

resources.Original: Adds Burst Strike into the rotation when appropriate.
resources.Translated: 在适当时机将爆发击加入循环。

resources.Original: Replaces the combo chain with Harvest Moon when outside of melee range.
resources.Translated: 在近战范围外时，将连击替换为收获月。

resources.Original: Adds Equilibrium to the one-button mitigation.
resources.Translated: 将泰然自若加入一键减伤。

resources.Original: Gives max priority to Holmgang when the Health percentage threshold is met.
resources.Translated: 当生命值百分比达到阈值时，给予死斗最高优先级。
强碎灵蛇 / 强碎灵蝰 护卫

resources.Original: Blocks Vicewinder / Vicepit when you already have Vicewinder / Vicepit active.
resources.Translated: 当你已激活强碎灵蛇 / 强碎灵蝰时，阻止再次使用强碎灵蛇 / 强碎灵蝰。

resources.Original: Will not use Slowga if the diminishing return from repeated use is substantial, or there would be no diminishing return at all.
resources.Translated: 若重复使用导致的递减效果显著，或完全没有递减效果，则不使用慢加。
等待获得完整（近似）效果
高级治疗模式 - 单体

resources.Original: Adds Defensive Role Action Rampart to Burst Mode below selected health
resources.Translated: 在低于所选生命值时，将防御职能技能铁壁加入爆发模式

resources.Original: Adds Heart Of Light to the one-button mitigation.
resources.Translated: 将光之心加入一键减伤。

resources.Original: Don't use Philosophia when under the effect of someone's Philosophia
resources.Translated: 当处于他人的智慧之爱效果下时，不使用智慧之爱

resources.Original: Adds Occult Resuscitation into the rotation.

resources.Translated: 车式浮空炮塔/后式自走人偶选项

resources.Original: Adds Rook Autoturret or Automaton Queen to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将车式浮空炮塔或后式自走人偶加入循环。

resources.Original: Replace Nascent Flash with Raw intuition when level synced below 76.
resources.Translated: 当等级同步至76级以下时，将原初的勇猛替换为原初的直觉。

resources.Original: Adds Hasty Mirage into the rotation.
Will retarget Vercure according to following Suboptions
resources.Translated: 将根据以下子选项重定向赤治疗

resources.Original:
Uses Elemental Star when available.
- Prioritizes Flare Star unless expiring.
resources.Translated:
元素之星可用时使用。
- 优先使用耀星，除非即将过期。
将炽天强袭替换为闪灼4

resources.Original: Adds Meditate when not moving, not having a target and being in combat.
resources.Translated: 在未移动、无目标且战斗中时添加默想。

resources.Original: Adds Double Down to Gnashing Fang under No Mercy when appropriate.
resources.Translated: 在无慈悲状态下适时将倍攻加入烈牙。

resources.Original: Replace Aeolian Edge with its combo chain.
resources.Translated: 将旋风刃替换为其连击链。

resources.Original:
Replaces Scatter with a full one-button AoE rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
resources.Translated:
将散碎替换为完整的单键群体循环。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。

resources.Original: Retargets Aurora to the Target's Target if they do not have the status active and you do not have aggro.
resources.Translated: 如果目标没有极光状态且你没有仇恨，则将极光重新指向目标的目标。

resources.Original: Adds Meikyo Shisui to the rotation.
Replaces Amplifier with Xenoglossy when at max Polyglot stacks.
resources.Translated: 当通晓层数满时，将详述替换为异言。

resources.Translated: 在隐匿挥割和束缚挥割上添加夜游魂衣连击（虚空/交错收割、团契、夜游魂切割、祭牲和完人）。

resources.Original: Uses Edge of Darkness if Darkside is about to expire (<10s).
resources.Translated: 如果暗黑即将过期（<10秒），则使用暗黑锋。

resources.Original: Adds Delirium (or Blood Weapon at lower levels) to the rotation on cooldown and when Darkside is up.
resources.Translated: 在冷却结束时且暗黑生效时，将错乱剑（或低等级时的嗜血）加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds Sonic Break into the rotation when appropriate.
resources.Translated: 适时将音速破加入循环。

resources.Original: Use Lost Blood Rage when available.
resources.Translated: 在可用时使用失传血怒。

resources.Original: Adds Arm's Length when 5 or more targets.
resources.Translated: 目标≥5个时加入亲疏自行。

resources.Original: Replaces Riposte with the basic melee combo.
resources.Translated: 将回刺替换为基础近战连击。

resources.Original: Adds Romeo's Ballad into the rotation.
Adds Radiant Encore to the Rotation after Finale.
resources.Translated: 在终曲后将光明神的返场余音加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds selected buffs to the rotation
resources.Translated: 将选定的增益加入循环

resources.Original: Adds Shadow Wall / Vigil to the one-button mitigation.
resources.Translated: 为一键减伤加入暗影墙 /  vigil。
为爆发模式加入螺旋气流。
使用盾牌猛击打断选项

resources.Original: Adds Shield Bash to the rotation when your target is casting, interruptible or not.
resources.Translated: 当目标正在咏唱时（无论是否可打断）将盾牌猛击加入循环。
简单治疗模式 - 单体

resources.Original:
Replaces Cure with a full one-button single target healing utility.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job. Particularly with autorotation.
resources.Translated:
将治疗替换为完整的一键单体治疗工具。
这是新手入门的理想选项，尤其适合自动循环。

resources.Original: Enable this to add Red Mage-specific actions into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 启用后将赤魔法师专属技能加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds Twinfang and Twinblood to the button.
resources.Translated: 为按钮添加双牙连术和双牙乱术。

resources.Original: Adds Drain Touch into the rotation (DPS, Heal, or Emergency mode).
resources.Translated: 将吸血触加入循环（输出、治疗或紧急模式）。

resources.Translated: 为对应的召唤物添加龙神迸发、不死鸟迸发、日光普照和星极超流。

resources.Original: Astral Flow/Enkindle/Lux Solaris on Demis Feature
resources.Translated: 半神技能：星极超流/内力迸发/日光普照

resources.Translated: 近战连击期间超出距离时添加续斩。会保留足够的魔力以完成当前连击。

resources.Original: Features and options involving shared role actions for Healers.
resources.Translated: 涉及治疗职能共用技能的设置与选项。

resources.Original: Turns Glare into an all-in-one damage button.
resources.Translated: 将闪耀变为集伤害于一体的按钮。
冷却好了就使用多变最后通牒。

resources.Translated: 拯救未激活或冷却中时变为心关。

resources.Original: Adds Role Action Smite to Burst Mode below selected health
resources.Translated: 在低于所选血量时，将职能技能重击加入爆发模式

resources.Original: Replace Armor Crush with its combo chain.
resources.Translated: 将强甲破点突替换为其连击链。

resources.Original: Adds Phantom Zeninage into the rotation.
Will retarget Unmend according to below settings.
resources.Translated: 将根据以下设置重新选择目标施放伤残。

resources.Original: Replaces Lay of the Lands or Arbor Calls with Prospect/Triangulate and Truth of Mountains/Forests if not active.
resources.Translated: 若未激活，将大地之诗或森林之诗替换为矿脉勘探/三角测量和山岳之相/森林之相。

resources.Original: Adds Gekko combo to the rotation.
Adds Feint when Raidwide is detected casting.
resources.Translated: 当检测到敌方正在咏唱全屏攻击时加入牵制。

resources.Original: Replaces Fleche with Contre Sixte, Vice of Thorns, Prefulgence, Engagement, and 1 charge of Corps-a-corps.
resources.Translated: 将飞刺替换为六分反击、荆棘环绕、光芒四射、交剑和1层短兵相接。

resources.Original: Adds Bow Shock to Gnashing Fang when available.
resources.Translated: 可用时将弓形冲波加入烈牙。

resources.Original: Adds Camouflage when 3 or more targets.
resources.Translated: 目标为3个或以上时使用伪装。

resources.Original: Adds missing Motifs to the combo while out of combat.
resources.Translated: 在战斗外为连击补充缺失的动机。

resources.Original:
Replaces Steel Fangs with a full one-button single target rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
resources.Translated:
将咬噬尖齿替换为完整的一键单体循环。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。

resources.Original:
Replaces Hakaze with a full one-button single target rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
resources.Translated:
将刃风替换为完整的一键单体循环。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。

resources.Original: Adds Thrill Of Battle when 3 or more targets
resources.Translated: 目标为3个或以上时使用战栗

resources.Original: Uses Three Mudra on Meisui when HP is under the set threshold.
resources.Translated: 当HP低于设定阈值时，对明镜止水使用三印自在。

resources.Original: Adds Occult Thunder II into the rotation (prefers Lightning Weakness).
resources.Translated: 将秘术闪雷II加入循环（优先看穿弱点：雷）。

resources.Original: Weaves Lucid Dreaming when your MP falls below the specified value.
resources.Translated: 当你的魔力低于指定值时插入醒梦。

resources.Original:
Adds Confiteor and it's Combo to Advanced Mode.
- At lower levels, uses Holy Circle instead.
resources.Translated:
将悔罪及其连击加入高级模式。
- 在较低等级时，改用圣环。
在冷却就绪时加入已装备的蛮神技能。

resources.Original:
Replaces Requiescat with all Requiescat-related actions.
- Prioritizes Confiteor and Blade actions when available.
- Uses Holy Spirit or Holy Circle when appropriate.
resources.Translated:
将安魂祈祷替换为所有与安魂祈祷相关的技能。
- 可用时优先使用悔罪和圣剑技能。
- 适当时使用圣灵或圣环。

resources.Original:
Includes Saber Dance in the rotation when at or over the Esprit threshold.
(And to prevent overcapping while under Technical Finish)
resources.Translated:
当伶俐达到或超过阈值时，将剑舞加入循环。
（并防止在技巧舞步结束期间溢出）

resources.Original: Adds SeitonTenchu to Burst Mode when the target is below threshold HP%.
resources.Translated: 当目标生命值低于阈值时，将星遁天诛加入爆发模式。

resources.Original: Adds Leg Sweep when target non-boss is casting.
resources.Translated: 当非首领目标正在咏唱时使用扫堂枪。

resources.Original: Adds Generations and Legacy weaves to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将世代与传承的穿插加入循环。

resources.Original: Enable this to add Ranger-specific actions into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 启用后将游侠专属技能加入循环。

resources.Original: Blocks Riposte when resources are too low to complete combo
resources.Translated: 当资源不足以完成连击时阻止回刺

resources.Original:
Adds Mitigation to the combos when not in a boss encounter. Will not overlap separate options unless stated.
Will not use mitigation in the first 15 seconds of a pull unless you are not moving.
resources.Translated:
非首领战时将减伤加入连击。除非另有说明，否则不会与其他选项重叠。
开怪前15秒内不会使用减伤，除非你处于静止状态。

resources.Original: Turns Peripheral Synthesis into Mustard Bomb when target is under the effect of Lightheaded.
resources.Translated: 当目标处于头晕状态时，将生成外设变为芥末爆弹。

resources.Original:
Adds Rattling Coil to Snake Scales when available.
- Requires Snake Scales to be on cooldown.
resources.Translated:
当飞蛇之魂可用时，将其加入蛇鳞术。
- 需要蛇鳞术处于冷却中。

resources.Original: Replaces Living Muse with One button Motifs
resources.Translated: 用一键动物构想替换动物构想

resources.Original: Adds Communio to Gibbet/Gallows and Guillotine.
resources.Translated: 将团契加入绞刑架/缢杀和断首。

resources.Original: Communio on Gibbet/Gallows and Guillotine Feature
resources.Translated: 绞刑架/缢杀和断首使用团契功能

resources.Original:
Add Triplecast to the rotation.
Will only be used if Swiftcast is on cooldown.
resources.Translated:
将三连咏唱加入循环。
仅在即刻咏唱处于冷却时使用。

resources.Original: Uses Plunge whilst in melee range, and not just as a gap-closer.
resources.Translated: 在近战范围内使用隐跳，而不仅仅作为位移手段。
将偷袭/介毒之术加入高级模式。

resources.Original: Retargets Aetherpact according to your Healing stack.
resources.Translated: 根据你的治疗量重新指定以太契约的目标。

resources.Original: Adds Basic Instinct when solo in a duty.
resources.Translated: 单人任务时加入斗争本能。

resources.Original: Locks out Capture if your current target is either not an eligible pet for capture, or you already have it unlocked. Disclaimer: May not be perfect. Detection methods are hypothetical at best.
resources.Translated: 当你的当前目标不是可捕获的宠物，或你已解锁该宠物时，禁用捕获。免责声明：可能并不完美。检测方法最多只是假设性的。

resources.Original: Blood Stalk and Grim Swathe will turn into Gluttony when it is available.
resources.Translated: 当暴食可用时，隐匿挥割和束缚挥割将变为暴食。

resources.Original: Gluttony on Blood Stalk/Grim Swathe Feature
resources.Translated: 隐匿挥割/束缚挥割变为暴食功能

resources.Original: Adds Vercure on self when solo or in a party with no healers.
resources.Translated: 在单人时或队伍中没有治疗师时，对自己使用赤治疗。

resources.Original: Adds Chaos Spring to Burst Mode when below the set HP percentage.
resources.Translated: 当生命值低于设定百分比时，将混沌之春加入爆发模式。

resources.Original: Adds Sonic Break into the AoE rotation when appropriate.
resources.Translated: 在适当时将音速破加入AoE循环。

resources.Original: Collection of Options to Retarget Manually-Used Single Target Heals.
resources.Translated: 用于重新指定手动使用的单体治疗目标的选项集合。

resources.Original: Adds Shadow of Death to the rotation.
Adds only Sacrificium on Blood Stalk and Grim Swathe while enshrouded.
resources.Translated: 在夜游魂状态下仅对隐匿挥割和束缚挥割添加祭牲。

resources.Original: Retargets Benediction to the heal stack.
resources.Translated: 将天赐祝福重新指向治疗队列。

resources.Original: Adds Hallowed Ground when 5 or more targets as part of the mitigation rotation. (Recommended)
resources.Translated: 当目标为5个或更多时，作为减伤循环的一部分添加神圣领域。（推荐）

resources.Original: Adds Blade Blitz into the rotation.

This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
将毁坏替换为完整的单键单体循环。
这是新手入门的理想选项。

resources.Original: Adds Demi summons to the single target combo.
resources.Translated: 将半神召唤加入单体连击。

resources.Original: Adds Defensive Role Action Rampart to Burst Mode below selected health
resources.Translated: 在低于所选生命值时，将防御职能技能铁壁加入爆发模式

resources.Original: Enable this to add Mystic Knight-specific actions into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 启用后将神秘骑士专属技能加入循环。

resources.Original: Will Retarget the Raises affected here to your Heal Stack.
resources.Translated: 将此处受影响的复活重新指向你的治疗队列。

resources.Original: Adds Lance Charge to the rotation.

resources.Translated: 根据所需将明镜止水替换为月光、花车和雪风。

resources.Original: Adds Bow Shock to Fated Circle when appropriate.
resources.Translated: 在适当时将弓形冲波加入命运之环。

resources.Original: Adds Invulnerability into the rotation (optionally saved for Starfall).
resources.Translated: 将不死宣告加入循环（可选择保留给落星池）。

resources.Original: Includes Ending and then Closed Position in the rotation when your current partner is not the optimal one, such as when they get a damage down.
resources.Translated: 当当前舞伴不是最优时（例如其获得伤害降低），在循环中加入结束动作和闭式舞姿。

resources.Original: Adds Occult Cure II into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将秘术治疗 II 加入循环。

resources.Original: Changes Benefic 2 to Benefic when Benefic 2 is not unlocked or available.
resources.Translated: 当吉星2未解锁或不可用时，将吉星2改为吉星。

resources.Original:
Turns Slice Combo into an all-in-one damage button.
Adds Soul Slice to the main combo.
resources.Translated:
将切割连击变为一体化伤害按钮。
将灵魂切割加入主连击。

resources.Original: Will Retarget the Raises affected here to your Heal Stack.
resources.Translated: 将此处受影响的复活重新指向你的治疗队列。

resources.Original: Add's Grim Swathe onto the main combo on cd
resources.Translated: 冷却好时将束缚挥割加入主连击

resources.Original: Replaces Art of War with options below.
resources.Translated: 将破阵法替换为以下选项。
高级输出模式 - 群体

resources.Original: Block Combos for Passage of Arms

Will block the main Combos while Passage of Arms is still active, to prevent actions from those combos cancelling Passage of Arms early.
This will leave it up to you to cancel Passage of Arms via other actions or movement (or letting it be used fully).
resources.Translated:
当武装戍卫仍处于激活状态时阻止主连击，以防止这些连击的动作提前取消武装戍卫。
这将由你通过其他动作或移动来取消武装戍卫（或让其完整施放）。

resources.Original: Replace Hot Shot with Drill, Air Anchor, Chainsaw and Excavator depending on which is on cooldown.
resources.Translated: 根据冷却情况将热弹替换为钻头、空气锚、链锯和掘地飞轮。

resources.Original: Essential Dignity will be added when the target is at or below the value set.
resources.Translated: 当目标生命值低于或等于设定值时，将加入先天禀赋。

resources.Translated: 在90/100级时加入太阳神之衡起手。

resources.Original: Adds Soul Slice to the rotation.

This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
将先锋剑替换为完整的单键单体循环。
这是新手入门的理想选择。

resources.Original: Turns Solid Barrel Combo into an all-in-one damage button.
resources.Translated: 将迅连斩连击变为一键式伤害按钮。

resources.Translated: 当可用时，将崛起之心及其连击链加入命运之环。

resources.Original: Adds Quietus to the rotation when the blood gauge is above the chosen threshold.
resources.Translated: 当血槽高于所选阈值时，将寂灭加入循环。

resources.Original: Use Variant Raise on incapacitated party members.
resources.Translated: 对力竭的队伍成员使用多变复活。
将分身之术加入高级模式。

resources.Original: Adds Bloodfest to Burst Strike when approrpiate.
resources.Translated: 在适当时将血壤加入爆发击。

resources.Original: Adds Silver Cannon into the rotation.
Adds Kardia Reminder to Burst Mode if buff is missing
resources.Translated: 若增益缺失，将心关提醒加入爆发模式

resources.Original: Use Variant Spirit Dart whenever the debuff is not present or less than 3s
resources.Translated: 当没有该减益或剩余时间少于3秒时使用多变精神镖

resources.Translated: 将生化冲击波加入爆发模式。
加入赤神圣/赤核爆、灼烧和解答所

resources.Translated: 将借力替换为你野兽的借用技能。在紧急情况下可能更难切换借力，请谨慎使用。

resources.Original: Adds Rampart to the one-button mitigation.

resources.Translated: 高级治疗模式 - 群体

resources.Original: Replaces Heart of Light with Reprisal when ready.
resources.Translated: 就绪时用雪仇剑替换光之心。

resources.Translated: 用一键式群体治疗设置替换医治。

resources.Translated: 当目标可被打断时，用伤头击替换伤足击。

resources.Original: Replaces Thrill Of Battle with an all-in-one mitigation button.
resources.Translated: 用一体化减伤按钮替换战栗。

resources.Original: Adds Dragon Force for tankbusters and raidwides.
resources.Translated: 为坦克死刑和全屏攻击添加龙之力。

resources.Original: Adds all Continuation procs to No Mercy when available.
resources.Translated: 可用时将续剑触发全部添加到无慈悲中。

resources.Original: Will Retarget the Closed Position shown out of combat to your optimal partner.
resources.Translated: 将脱战状态下显示的闭式舞姿重新选择为你的最优舞伴。

resources.Original: Adds Rampart to the one-button mitigation.

resources.Translated: 在首领战中为连击添加减伤。除非另有说明，否则不会与单独的选项重叠。

resources.Translated: 当你超出近战范围、GCD未在滚动且技能可用时，将收获月添加到主连击。当敌人生命值低于12k时也会投掷以处决

resources.Translated: 检测到即将到来的坦克死刑时添加暗影墙/暗影卫。不会与铁壁重叠。
暗影墙/暗影卫 坦克死刑选项

resources.Original: Changes Swiftcast to Raise when on cooldown.
resources.Translated: 即刻咏唱冷却时改为复活。

resources.Original:
Replaces Overpower with a full one-button AoE rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
resources.Translated:
将超压斧替换为完整的单键AoE循环。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。

resources.Original: Prioritizes Recitation usage on Excogitation or Indomitability.
resources.Translated: 优先将秘策用于深谋远虑之策或不屈不挠之策。

resources.Original: Uses Phlegma if available. When Psyche is also enabled, pairs Phlegma → Psyche → Phlegma.
resources.Translated: 可用时使用发炎。当灵能也启用时，按发炎 → 灵能 → 发炎的顺序释放。

resources.Original: Turns Aeolian Edge Combo into an all-in-one damage button.
resources.Translated: 将旋风刃连击变为一键伤害按钮。

resources.Original: Adds Leg Sweep when target non-boss is casting.
resources.Translated: 当非首领目标正在咏唱时使用扫堂枪。

resources.Original: Allows use of Bloodwhetting any time, not just between GCDs.
resources.Translated: 允许随时使用原初的血气，而不仅限于GCD之间。

resources.Original: If Aetherflow is on cooldown, show Dissipation instead.
resources.Translated: 如果以太超流在冷却中，则显示转化。

resources.Original: Enable this to add Dragoon-specific actions into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 启用后将龙骑士专属技能加入循环。

resources.Original:
Turns Jolt III into an all-in-one button.
- Will not attempt to cast Jolt III while moving.
resources.Translated:
将激荡变为一键按钮。
- 移动时不会尝试施放激荡。

resources.Original: Adds Glare IV to the AoE combo when under Sacred Sight
resources.Translated: 在闪飒预备状态下将闪飒IV加入AoE连击

resources.Original: Will Retarget the Raise affected here to your Heal Stack.
resources.Translated: 将此处受影响的复活重新指定给你的治疗小队。

resources.Original: Weaves your Balance or Spear card (best used with Quick Target Cards)
resources.Translated: 插入你的太阳神之衡或战争神之枪卡牌（最好配合快速目标卡牌使用）

resources.Original: Adds Reign of Beasts & its combo chain to Gnashing Fang when available.
resources.Translated: 可用时将崛起之心及其连击链加入烈牙。

resources.Original: Retargets Diagnosis according to your Healing stack.
resources.Translated: 根据你的治疗量重新选择诊断的目标。

resources.Original: Collection of Cooldown features on main combo.
resources.Translated: 主连击上的冷却技能合集。

resources.Original: Adds Occult Dispel into the rotation if the target has a known-dispellable status.
resources.Translated: 如果目标带有已知可驱散的状态，则将魔驱魔加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds Primal Scream to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将原初的怒号加入爆发模式。

resources.Original: Adds Adloquium when target is below set health
resources.Translated: 当目标生命值低于设定值时使用鼓舞激励之策

resources.Original: Adds Meteodrive Limit break to Burst Mode when target is below 20k and guarded
resources.Translated: 当目标生命值低于20k且处于防御状态时，将陨石冲击极限技加入爆发模式

resources.Original: Adds Fuma Shuriken to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将风魔手里剑加入爆发模式。

resources.Original: Adds Blackest Night to Burst mode.
resources.Translated: 将至黑之夜加入爆发模式。

resources.Original: Adds Afflatus Misery to the AoE combo when it is ready to be used.
resources.Translated: 当苦难之心就绪时，将其加入群体攻击循环。

resources.Original: Includes Dance of the Dawn in the rotation after Saber Dance and when over the threshold, or in the final seconds of Dance of the Dawn ready.
resources.Translated: 在剑舞之后且超过阈值时，或在拂晓舞就绪的最后几秒内，将拂晓舞加入循环。

resources.Original:
Replaces Blizzard II with a full one-button AoE rotation.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
将冰结II替换为一键式完整群体攻击循环。
这是新手入门的理想选择。

resources.Original:
Adds Zwerchhau & Redoublement. 
**Must be in melee range or have Gap close with Corps-a-corps enabled**
resources.Translated:
加入交击斩和连攻。
**必须处于近战范围内，或已启用短兵相接作为位移手段**

resources.Original: Changes the class' Raise Ability into Swiftcast. Red Mage will also show VerCure if Swiftcast is on cooldown.
resources.Translated: 将职业的复活技能改为即刻咏唱。若即刻咏唱处于冷却中，赤魔法师还会显示赤治疗。
魔法远程输出：复活功能

resources.Original: Adds Mountain Buster to Burst Mode.

Adds Tempera Coat when Raidwide is detected casting. 
Spreads it with Tempera Grassa if enough party members are in range. More than 75%
resources.Translated:
检测到全屏攻击读条时加入坦培拉涂层。
若范围内队员足够多则用油性坦培拉涂层扩散。超过75%
全屏攻击节制连招选项

resources.Original:
Will try to Weave Temperance and Divine Caress when a raidwide casting. 
Will be used in all 4 main combos.
resources.Translated:
检测到全屏攻击读条时尝试插入节制和神爱抚。
将在全部4个主要连招中使用。

resources.Translated: 在忍术阶段阻止操作，以防手动使用忍术失败。

resources.Original:
Replaces Hard Slash with a full one-button single target rotation.
