resources.Original: Adds Disesteem to the rotation when available.
resources.Translated: 当可用时，将不尊重添加到轮换中。

resources.Original: Adds Winged Reprobation to the combo.
resources.Translated: 将有翼谴责添加到组合中。

resources.Original:
Replaces Helios with a full one-button single target healing utility.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job. Particularly with autorotation.
resources.Translated:
用完整的一键单目标治疗实用程序取代 Helios。
对于新入职的人来说，这是理想的选择。特别是自转。

resources.Original: Adds Uncoiled Fury to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将展开的愤怒添加到旋转中。

resources.Original: Adds Quickstep into the rotation when targetted by an enemy.
resources.Translated: 当被敌人瞄准时，将快速步添加到轮换中。

resources.Original:
If your target's target is not you, will Retarget The Blackest Night onto them.
(if you're not top aggro, and not mousing over or hard targeting an ally)
resources.Translated:
如果你的目标不是你，会将至黑之夜重新定位到他们身上。
（如果你不是顶级仇恨，并且没有将鼠标悬停在或硬瞄准盟友）

resources.Original:
Adds Lemure's Slice to the main combo during the Enshroud burst phase.
Contains burst options.
resources.Translated:
在裹尸布爆发阶段将莱穆尔的切片添加到主要组合中。
包含连拍选项。
将（高）跳跃添加到旋转中。

resources.Original:
Adds buffs onto the Advanced Bard feature. 
Enable all to follow balance buff windows 
Disabling any buff will follow simple priority
resources.Translated:
为高级吟游诗人功能添加增益。 
让所有人都遵循平衡增益窗口 
禁用任何增益将遵循简单的优先级

resources.Original: Adds Shade Shift to Advanced Mode.
resources.Translated: 将色调转换添加到高级模式。

resources.Original: Retargets Cure 3 to the heal stack.
resources.Translated: 将治疗 3 重新定位到治疗堆栈。

resources.Original: Adds Low Blow to the rotation when your target is casting.
resources.Translated: 当你的目标施法时，为旋转添加低击。

resources.Original: Will maintain dots on up to 3 targets.
resources.Translated: 最多可在 3 个目标上保留点。

resources.Original: Adds Leg Sweep when target non-boss is casting.
resources.Translated: 当目标非 Boss 施法时添加扫腿。

resources.Original: Includes Curing Waltz and Second Wind in the AoE rotation when available and your HP is below the set percentages.
resources.Translated: 如果可用并且您的 HP 低于设定百分比，则在 AoE 轮换中包括治愈华尔兹和第二风。

resources.Original:
Adds Heart of Stone/Corundrum when available. 
- NOTE: This feature will overlap with others.
resources.Translated:
添加石心/刚玉（如果可用）。 
- 注意：此功能将与其他功能重叠。

resources.Original: Change Whispering Dawn into Fey Illumination, Fey Blessing, then Whispering Dawn when used.
resources.Translated: 使用时将黎明低语改为精类照明、精类祝福，然后使用黎明低语。

resources.Original: Adds Sentinel/Guardian when an incoming tankbuster is detected. Will not overlap with Rampart.
resources.Translated: 当检测到即将到来的坦克破坏者时添加哨兵/守护者。不会与城墙重叠。

resources.Original: Allows for a custom priority and selection of mudras when under the Three Mudra effect.
resources.Translated: 在三手印效果下允许自定义优先级和选择手印。
哨兵/守护者坦克毁灭者选项
将夜之花添加到组合中。

resources.Original: Adds Judgment Bolt into the rotation (prefers Lightning Weakness).
resources.Translated: 将审判箭添加到轮换中（更喜欢闪电弱点）。

resources.Original: Adds Holy in White to the combo when it will strike 2 targets.
resources.Translated: 当它攻击 2 个目标时，将白圣添加到连击中。

resources.Original:
Enable this to add Variant Actions in Variant Dungeons.
Variant Actions will be used by Single Target and AoE DPS Combos, in both Simple & Advanced
resources.Translated:
启用此选项可在变体地下城中添加变体动作。
在简单和高级中，单一目标和 AoE DPS 组合将使用变体动作

resources.Original: Adds Salt and Darkness to Burst mode.
resources.Translated: 为连拍模式添加盐和黑暗。

resources.Original: Adds Breath of Magic to DPS Mode.
resources.Translated: 将魔法之息添加到 DPS 模式。

resources.Original: Adds Dark Missionary when raidwide casting is detected.
resources.Translated: 当检测到团队施法时添加黑暗传教士。

resources.Original: Enable this to add Oracle-specific actions into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 启用此选项可将 Oracle 特定操作添加到轮换中。

resources.Original: Retargets Cure II to the heal stack.
resources.Translated: 将治愈 II 重新定位到治疗堆栈。

resources.Original: Adds Rook Autoturret or Automaton Queen to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将 Rook Autoturret 或 Automaton Queen 添加到轮换中。
Rook 自动炮塔/自动机皇后选项

resources.Original:
Turns Feather Rain into Shock Strike, Rose of Destruction, and Glass Dance.
Will cause primals to desync from Moon Flute burst phases if used on cooldown.
Feather Rain is Retargeted to your target, so you don't have to place it.
resources.Translated:
将羽雨变为震击、毁灭玫瑰、琉璃之舞。
如果在冷却时使用，将导致原始生物与月笛爆发阶段不同步。
羽雨会重新定位到您的目标，因此您无需放置它。

resources.Original: Replaces Cast Light with Electric Current when diving.
resources.Translated: 潜水时用电流代替投射灯。

resources.Original: Cast Light to Electric Current Option
Adds Onslaught to Fell Cleave when available.
resources.Translated: 如果有的话，将猛攻添加到堕落顺劈中。

resources.Original: Adds Arcane Circle to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将奥术圆添加到旋转中。
将蒂拉纳纳入轮换阵容。

resources.Original:
Adds Purify when affected by crowd control.
- Requires Purify to be available.
resources.Translated:
受人群控制影响时添加净化。
- 需要 Purify 可用。

resources.Original: Adds Mitigation to the combos when in a boss encounter.
resources.Translated: 在遭遇 Boss 时为连击添加缓解效果。

resources.Original: Adds Ringing Respite into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将响铃暂息添加到轮换中。

resources.Original: Adds Titan to the Single Target Rotation
resources.Translated: 将泰坦添加到单一目标旋转中

resources.Original: Adds the Balance opener at level 100.
resources.Translated: 在 100 级添加平衡开启器。

resources.Original: Adds Wildfire to the feature when off cooldown and overheated.
resources.Translated: 在关闭冷却和过热时将野火添加到功能中。

resources.Original: Adds Chaos Drive into the rotation (prefers Lightning Weakness).
resources.Translated: 将混沌驱动添加到旋转中（更喜欢闪电弱点）。

resources.Original: Adds Hell Wind into the rotation (prefers Wind Weakness).
resources.Translated: 将地狱风添加到轮换中（首选风弱）。

resources.Original: Will retarget Tomahawk to according to below settings.
resources.Translated: 将根据以下设置重新定位战斧。

resources.Original: Adds Bloodfest to No Mercy when appropriate.
resources.Translated: 在适当的时候将鲜血节添加到无情中。

resources.Original: Blocks Moulinet when resources are too low to complete combo
resources.Translated: 当资源太低而无法完成组合时阻止 Moulinet

resources.Original: Adds Energy Siphon and Painflare to the AoE combo.
resources.Translated: 将能量虹吸和痛苦耀斑添加到 AoE 组合中。
将 Geirskogul 添加到突发模式。

resources.Original: Retargets Phantom Cure II. Retargets if anyone in your party is below the slider above.
resources.Translated: 重新定位《幻影治愈 II》。如果您队伍中的任何人位于上方滑块下方，则重新定位。

resources.Original: Replaces Ageless Words and Solid Reason with Wise to the World when available
resources.Translated: 如果有的话，用对世界的智慧取代永恒的话语和坚实的理性

resources.Original:
Adds Rampart when tankbuster is detected.
- NOTE: This feature will not overlap with Nebula.
resources.Translated:
当检测到坦克破坏者时添加壁垒。
- 注意：此功能不会与星云重叠。

resources.Original: Adds Shadow Wall/Shadowed Vigil when 5 or more targets.
resources.Translated: 当有 5 个或更多目标时添加暗影墙/暗影守夜。

resources.Original: Change Recitation into either Adloquium, Succor, Indomitability, or Excogitation when used.
resources.Translated: 使用时将背诵更改为 Adloquium、Succor、Indomitability 或 Excogitation。

resources.Original: Adds Rook or Queen Overdrive to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将车或后超速添加到轮换中。

resources.Original: Adds Uncoiled Fury to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将展开的愤怒添加到旋转中。

resources.Original: Adds Addle when Raidwide is detected casting.
resources.Translated: 当 Raidwide 检测到施法时添加 Addle。

resources.Original: Replace Oka with its combo chain.
Replaces Dark Missionary with Reprisal when ready.
resources.Translated: 准备好后用报复取代黑暗传教士。

resources.Original: Adds Mantra when Raidwide is detected casting.
resources.Translated: 当 Raidwide 检测到施法时添加咒语。
将 Necrotize 添加到突发模式。

resources.Original: Replace Nightmare Scythe with its combo chain.
resources.Translated: 用组合链替换梦魇镰刀。

resources.Original: Applies Kardia if it's not applied to anyone.
resources.Translated: 如果不适用于任何人，则适用 Kardia。

resources.Original: Adds Impalement to the rotation when Delirium is active.
resources.Translated: 当谵妄处于活动状态时，将穿刺添加到旋转中。
将防守加入轮换阵容中。

resources.Original:
Adds Occult Elixir into the rotation.
Requires Occult Elixir in inventory.
resources.Translated:
将神秘药剂添加到循环中。
需要库存中的神秘药剂。

resources.Original: Adds Feint when Raidwide is detected casting.
resources.Translated: 当 Raidwide 检测到施法时添加佯攻。

resources.Original:
Options for Fan Dance combos.
Fan Dance 3 takes priority over Fan Dance 4.
resources.Translated:
扇子舞组合选项。
扇子舞 3 优先于扇子舞 4。

resources.Original:
Requires a target within 8 Yalms. 
Skill itself requires none usually, this is for the range check.
resources.Translated:
要求目标在 8 Yalm 以内。 
技能本身通常不需要，这是为了范围检查。
战斧正常运行时间选项

resources.Original: Adds Tomahawk into the rotation when you are out of range.
resources.Translated: 当您超出范围时，将战斧添加到轮换中。

resources.Original: Applies Esuna if there is a cleansable debuff.
resources.Translated: 如果存在可清除的减益效果，则适用埃苏纳。

resources.Original: Will hold one charge for manual displacement usage.
resources.Translated: 可为手动排量使用保留一次电量。

resources.Original: Adds Chaos Spring to Burst Mode when target is below 8k health because it goes through guard.
resources.Translated: 当目标生命值低于 8k 时，将混沌之泉添加到爆发模式，因为它会经过守卫。

resources.Original: Adds Salted Earth to Burst mode.
resources.Translated: 将 Salted Earth 添加到连拍模式。

resources.Original:
Adds Honing Dance to the main combo when in melee range (respects global offset).
This option prevents early use of Honing Ovation!
Keep Honing Dance bound to another key if you want to end early.
resources.Translated:
在近战范围内将珩磨之舞添加到主要组合中（尊重全局偏移）。
此选项可防止过早使用 Honing Ovation！
如果您想提前结束，请将珩磨之舞绑定到另一个键。

resources.Original: Adds Arm's Length when 5 or more targets.
resources.Translated: 当有 5 个或更多目标时，增加手臂距离。

resources.Original:
Replaces Blizzard I with a full one-button single target rotation.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
用完整的一键单目标旋转取代了暴雪 I。
对于新入职的人来说，这是理想的选择。
简单模式 - 单一目标
将 Enshroud 添加到旋转中。

resources.Original:
Replace Full Thrust/Heavens' Thrust with the basic combo chain.
Enabling Chaos combo option makes this a one button basic combo.
resources.Translated:
将全推力/天推力替换为基本组合链。
启用混沌组合选项使其成为一键基本组合。

resources.Original:
Replaces Total Eclipse with a full one-button AoE rotation.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
用完整的一键 AoE 旋转取代 Total Eclipse。
对于新入职的人来说，这是理想的选择。
如果可用，请使用失落的咒法铸造。

resources.Original: Replaces Goblin Punch with a full one-button single target tank rotation.
resources.Translated: 用完整的一键单目标坦克旋转取代哥布林拳。

resources.Original: Adds Living Shadow to the rotation when Darkside is up.
resources.Translated: 当暗面出现时，将活影添加到旋转中。

resources.Original: Role Action Eagle Eye Shot Option
resources.Translated: 角色动作鹰眼射击选项

resources.Original:
Automatically Adds Eagle Eye Shot to Burst Mode when target is guarded or under selected health percentage 
 WILL ONLY WORK IN LARGE SCALE PVP
resources.Translated:
当目标被守卫或低于选定的健康百分比时，自动将鹰眼射击添加到突发模式 
 仅适用于大规模 PVP

resources.Original: Adds Danger/Blasting Zone into the rotation when available.
resources.Translated: 如果可用，将危险/爆炸区域添加到轮换中。
重新定位最黑的夜晚功能

resources.Original: Will Retarget The Blackest Night outside of other combos to your MouseOver Target (or a friendly Hard Target).
resources.Translated: 将其他组合之外的“至黑之夜”重新定位到您的鼠标悬停目标（或友好的硬目标）。

resources.Original: Changes Painflare to Ruin IV when out of Aetherflow stacks, Energy Siphon is on cooldown, and Ruin IV is up.
resources.Translated: 当以太流层数耗尽时，将痛苦耀斑更改为毁灭 IV，能量虹吸处于冷却状态，并且毁灭 IV 已启动。

resources.Original: Includes Fan Dance 3 when under Threefold Fan Dance.
resources.Translated: 在三重扇子舞下包含扇子舞 3。
废墟 IV 痛苦耀斑选项

resources.Original: Enable this to add Thief-specific actions into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 启用此选项可将 Thief 特定操作添加到轮换中。

resources.Original: Adds Magick Barrier when Raidwide is detected casting.
resources.Translated: 当 Raidwide 检测到施法时添加魔法屏障。

resources.Original: Replace Iaijutsu with Tsubame-gaeshi when appropriate.
resources.Translated: 在适当的时候用燕变术代替居合术。

resources.Original: Will use Higanbana depending on suboptions.
resources.Translated: 根据子选项将使用彼岸花。

resources.Original: Adds True North when under Gluttony.
resources.Translated: 在暴食状态下添加正北。

resources.Original: Prevents you from wasting actions if under the effect of someone else's actions
resources.Translated: 防止您在他人行为的影响下浪费行为

resources.Original: Prevents the use of Dismantle when target already has the effect.
resources.Translated: 当目标已经具有拆除效果时，防止使用拆除。

resources.Original:
Adds Reprisal to the one-button mitigation.
NOTE: Will not use unless there is a target within range to prevent waste
resources.Translated:
将报复添加到一键式缓解中。
注意：除非在范围内有目标，否则不会使用，以防止浪费

resources.Original: Pools Bloodletter charges and Sidewinder to allow for optimum burst phases
resources.Translated: 池放血弹和响尾蛇以实现最佳爆发阶段

resources.Original: Will Retarget Rekindle to a tank that needs it, then a party member that need healing, before Self.
resources.Translated: 将重新定位重新点燃需要它的坦克，然后是需要治疗的党员，然后是自我。
重新定位重新点燃组合选项

resources.Original: Standard Step to Last Dance Feature
resources.Translated: 标准舞步到最后一支舞功能

resources.Original: Change Standard Step or Finishing Move to Last Dance when available.
resources.Translated: 如果可用，请将标准步或结束动作更改为最后一支舞。

resources.Original: Adds Sheltron when an incoming tankbuster is detected
resources.Translated: 当检测到来袭的坦克杀手时添加 Sheltron

resources.Original: Adds Fuma Shuriken to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将风魔手里剑添加到连拍模式。

resources.Original: Weave Sidewinder, Empyreal arrow, Rain of death, and Pitch perfect when available.
resources.Translated: 编织响尾蛇、九重天箭、死亡之雨和完美音调（如果可用）。

resources.Original: Replaces Uncoiled Fury with Uncoiled Twinfang and Uncoiled Twinblood.
resources.Translated: 用展开的双牙和展开的双血取代展开的狂怒。

resources.Original: Adds Occult Mage Masher into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将神秘法师粉碎者添加到轮换中。

resources.Original:
Adds Asylum placement, when standing still, to the rotation.
Will Retarget it onto yourself.
resources.Translated:
当站立不动时，将庇护安置添加到轮换中。
将把它重新定位到你自己身上。

resources.Original: Use Lost Aether Shield when available.
resources.Translated: 如果可用，请使用失落的以太护盾。

resources.Original: Adds Creature Motif to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将生物图案添加到连拍模式。
将 Stardiver 添加到轮换中。
将 Foul/Xenoglossy 添加到轮换中。
如果可用，请使用“失手再加注”。

resources.Original:
Replaces Prognosis with a full one-button single target healing utility.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job. Particularly with autorotation.
resources.Translated:
用完整的一键式单目标治疗实用程序取代 Prognosis。
对于新入职的人来说，这是理想的选择。特别是自转。

resources.Original: Retargets Divine Benison to the heal stack (even from the Mitigation Feature above).
resources.Translated: 将神圣贝尼森重新定位到治疗堆栈（甚至从上面的缓解功能）。

resources.Original: Will retain a charge of Essential Dignity to use at a different threshold.
resources.Translated: 将保留基本尊严费用以在不同的阈值下使用。

resources.Original: Adds Thunderstorm into the rotation (prefers Wind Weakness).
resources.Translated: 将雷暴添加到轮换中（首选风弱）。

resources.Original:
Uses Slither when outside melee.
- Must remain within maximum range.
- Will not use if already under Slither's effect.
resources.Translated:
在近战之外使用滑行。
- 必须保持在最大范围内。
- 如果已经受到滑行者的影响，则不会使用。

resources.Original: Replace Storm's Eye with its combo chain.
resources.Translated: 用它的组合链取代暴风之眼。

resources.Original: Include all dance steps, and Finish, and optionally Standard Step, in the AoE rotation.
resources.Translated: 在 AoE 循环中包括所有舞步、完成以及可选的标准舞步。

resources.Original: Adds Death Warrant onto the main combo during the Enshroud burst when available.
resources.Translated: 如果可用，在裹尸布爆发期间将死亡令添加到主组合上。

resources.Original: Adds Role Action Smite to Burst Mode below selected health
resources.Translated: 将角色动作重击添加到低于选定生命值的爆发模式
角色 动作 重击选项

resources.Original: Use Variant Raise on incapacitated party members.
resources.Translated: 对无行为能力的队员使用变体加薪。

resources.Original: Adds Grim Swathe to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将 Grim Swhe 添加到旋转中。

resources.Original: If both DoTs are applied, returns Iron Jaws if able to be used.
resources.Translated: 如果应用了两个 DoT，则返回铁颚（如果可以使用）。

resources.Original: Retargets Synastry to the heal stack.
resources.Translated: 将 Synastry 重新定位到治疗堆栈。

resources.Original: Adds Ifrit to the Single Target Rotation
resources.Translated: 将 Ifrit 添加到单个目标旋转中

resources.Original: Use Variant Cure when HP is below set threshold.
resources.Translated: 当生命值低于设定阈值时使用变异治疗。

resources.Original: Adds Rekindle to the single target combo.
resources.Translated: 将重燃添加到单个目标组合中。

resources.Original: Adds Lucid Dreaming to the combo.
resources.Translated: 将清醒梦添加到组合中。

resources.Original: Adds Arcane Circle to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将奥术圆添加到旋转中。

resources.Original: Adds Occult Aqua Breath into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将神秘水族呼吸添加到轮换中。

resources.Original: Adds Interject to the rotation when your target's cast is interruptible.
resources.Translated: 当目标的施法可被打断时，将插入添加到轮换中。

resources.Original:
Retargets Heart of Stone/Corundum to the Target's Target if you do not have aggro.
	- NOTE: This can still be overridden with Mouseover.
resources.Translated:
如果你没有仇恨，将石心/刚玉重新定位到目标的目标。
	- 注意：这仍然可以通过鼠标悬停来覆盖。

resources.Original: Consolidates paint-consuming actions into one button.
resources.Translated: 将消耗油漆的操作整合到一个按钮中。

resources.Original: Will retarget Clemency according to following Suboptions
resources.Translated: 将根据以下子选项重新定位宽恕

resources.Original: Adds Lance Charge to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将长矛冲锋添加到轮换中。

resources.Original: Replace fishing abilities with diving abilities when underwater
resources.Translated: 水下时用潜水能力取代钓鱼能力

resources.Original: Adds Rainbow Drip to the burst phase.
resources.Translated: 将彩虹滴水添加到爆发阶段。

resources.Original: Adds Swiftcast to the combo while moving.
resources.Translated: 在移动时将 Swiftcast 添加到组合中。

resources.Original: If mousing over an ally in the UI, will Retarget Nascent Flash onto them.
resources.Translated: 如果将鼠标悬停在用户界面中的盟友上，会将新生闪光重新定位到他们身上。

已知以下插件与 {0} 冲突：

{1}

建议您禁用这些插件或它们的轮换
组件，以防止意外行为和错误。

resources.Original: You have conflict(s) in your Dalamud config:
resources.Translated: 您的 Dalamud 配置中存在冲突：

resources.Original: Action Replacing OFF    Your current job has PvP Combos on, and you're in a PVP zone; Wrath cannot work in this state.
resources.Translated: 行动 更换 关闭 您当前的工作已开启 PvP 连击，并且您处于 PVP 区域；愤怒在这种状态下无法发挥作用。

resources.Original: Options > Treat all friendly actions as mouseovers
resources.Translated: 选项 > 将所有友好操作视为鼠标悬停
堆栈 > {0} > “所有有益操作”已重定向

resources.Original: Character Configuration > Control Settings > Target > Target Settings > Automatically face target when using action.    You will have to manually face the target, outside of Auto Rotation, for actions to execute.
resources.Translated: 角色配置>控制设置>目标>目标设置>使用动作时自动面对目标。    您必须在自动旋转之外手动面对目标才能执行操作。

resources.Original: Whole Plugin - Could be causing Bunnies [Reload or Disable Redirect]
resources.Translated: 整个插件 - 可能会导致兔子 [重新加载或禁用重定向]

resources.Original: Autorotation Preset is enabled WITH targeting [remove 'Automatic Targeting' from preset or use a non-default preset]
resources.Translated: 自动旋转预设启用了定位 [从预设中删除“自动定位”或使用非默认预设]

resources.Original: AI is enabled WITH targeting [check 'Manual targeting']
resources.Translated: AI 通过定位启用[选中“手动定位”]

resources.Original:
Your configuration in the following plugins will conflict
with {0}'s enabled Action Retargeting:
{1}

It is recommended you disable these plugins, or
remove the conflicting actions from their settings, or
disable Retargeting for the action in {0},
to prevent unexpected behavior and bugs.
resources.Translated:
您在以下插件中的配置会发生冲突
启用了 {0} 的操作重定向：
{1}

建议您禁用这些插件，或者
从其设置中删除冲突的操作，或者
对 {0} 中的操作禁用重定向，
以防止意外行为和错误。

resources.Original: AI is enabled without disabling auto-target [check 'Disable auto-target']
resources.Translated: 启用人工智能而不禁用自动目标[选中“禁用自动目标”]

resources.Original: Smart Ability Targeting is Enabled [uncheck 'Use Smart Ability Targeting']
resources.Translated: 智能能力定位已启用[取消选中“使用智能能力定位”]

resources.Original: Tip: If a combo replaces an action, you can drag the action directly from this window to your hotbar!
resources.Translated: 提示：如果组合替换了某个操作，您可以将该操作直接从该窗口拖到您的快捷栏！

resources.Original: You had one of these tanks configured! Please Read!
resources.Translated: 您已经配置了其中一辆坦克！请阅读！
改进了 Raidwide 检测，添加了 Tankbuster 检测

resources.Original: This is for the Single Target DPS combos.
resources.Translated: 这是针对单目标 DPS 组合的。

resources.Original: This is for the AoE DPS combos.
resources.Translated: 这是针对 AoE DPS 组合的。

resources.Original: Tank In-Combo Mitigation Has Been Overhauled and Moved
resources.Translated: 坦克组合缓解措施已被彻底检修和移动

resources.Original: God says no! We don't want you to use actions currently.
resources.Translated: 神说不！我们当前不希望您使用操作。

resources.Original: These are buttons which serve to control the plugin in some way. Just drag the icon to your hotbar to use them.
resources.Translated: 这些按钮用于以某种方式控制插件。只需将图标拖到快捷栏即可使用它们。

resources.Original: Don't Override Icons with Job Actions (drag action to hotbar again to take effect)
resources.Translated: 不要用作业操作覆盖图标（再次将操作拖动到快捷栏即可生效）

resources.Original: This will hide all combo outputs on custom actions, leaving only these icons showing. This is not advised if you wish to see the real actions being output by the combos on your hotbar, and should only be used if you feel it's something you want.
resources.Translated: 这将隐藏自定义操作的所有组合输出，仅显示这些图标。如果您希望看到热键栏上的组合输出的实际操作，则不建议这样做，并且只有在您觉得这是您想要的东西时才应使用。

resources.Original:
These buttons replace the need to replace actions for all features marked as either Simple or Advanced. Enable the type of combo you're wanting to use custom actions for, and drag the icon to your hotbar.

This frees up the actions for manual use, for example, for downtime where you only want to use 1-2-3 combos, or for healers to always have access to basic healing actions.
resources.Translated:
这些按钮取代了替换标记为“简单”或“高级”的所有功能的操作的需要。启用您想要使用自定义操作的组合类型，并将图标拖动到快捷栏。

这可以释放手动使用的操作，例如，在您只想使用 1-2-3 连击的停机时间，或者让治疗者始终可以使用基本治疗操作。

resources.Original: This is for the AoE Heal combos.
resources.Translated: 这是针对 AoE 治疗组合的。

resources.Original: Switches between enabled and disabled for auto-rotation
resources.Translated: 在启用和禁用自动旋转之间切换
> 打开 Gun Breaker 的配置

resources.Original:
Raidwide detection has been improved to now also check for nearby
stack marker visual effects, in addition to the existing raidwide cast detection.
(No change by you is needed for this, it's just expanded now)

Tankbuster detection has been added by checking for visual effects!
Options to mitigate as a tank for these is in the new mitigation options above.

Find the new tankbuster mitigation options here:
PvE Features > [Tank of choice] > Advanced Mitigation Options > Boss Encounter
(can also search for 'Tankbuster' in your tank's configuration)
resources.Translated:
Raidwide 检测已得到改进，现在还可以检查附近的情况
除了现有的团队范围施放检测之外，堆栈标记视觉效果。
（您不需要对此进行任何更改，它现在只是扩展）

通过检查视觉效果添加了 Tankbuster 检测！
作为这些问题的坦克来缓解的选项在上面的新缓解选项中。

在这里找到新的坦克破坏者缓解选项：
PvE 功能 > [选择坦克] > 高级缓解选项 > Boss 遭遇
（也可以在坦克配置中搜索“Tankbuster”）

resources.Original:
Please note that even if you do not have all the required spells active, you may still use these features.
Any spells you do not have active will be skipped over so if a feature is not working as intended then
please try and enable more required spells.
resources.Translated:
请注意，即使您没有激活所有必需的法术，您仍然可以使用这些功能。
您没有激活的任何咒语都将被跳过，因此如果某个功能未按预期工作，那么
请尝试启用更多所需的咒语。

resources.Original:
Tanks have had their In-Combo Mitigation completely overhauled.
No longer is their mitigation settings in each combo, and no longer is mitigation entirely triggered by HP%.
Mitigation is now in its own Section, under the Advanced Combos, and those options apply to the Advanced Combos
if they have 'Include Mitigations' checked.
(Simple Modes will use the recommended values for these settings, if 'Include Mitigations' is checked there)

You can find these moved mitigation settings here:
PvE Features > [Tank of choice] > Advanced Mitigation Options

Make sure Mitigation is enabled in combos for these to work:
PvE Features > [Tank of choice] > Advanced/Simple Combo > Include Mitigations
resources.Translated:
坦克的组合缓解措施已得到彻底检修。
不再是每个组合中的缓解设置，也不再完全由 HP% 触发。
缓解措施现在位于高级组合下的独立部分中，这些选项适用于高级组合
如果他们选中了“包括缓解措施”。
（如果选中“包括缓解措施”，简单模式将使用这些设置的建议值）

您可以在此处找到这些已移动的缓解设置：
PvE 功能 > [选择坦克] > 高级缓解选项

确保在组合中启用缓解措施才能发挥作用：
PvE 功能 > [选择坦克] > 高级/简单组合 > 包括缓解措施

resources.Original: Close and Do Not Show again
This is for the Single Target Heal combos.
resources.Translated: 这是针对单一目标治疗组合的。

resources.Original: This section contains a range of bespoke "Custom Actions" which can be used as replacements for either base action replacements or specific macros.
resources.Translated: 本节包含一系列定制的“自定义操作”，可用作基本操作替换或特定宏的替换。

resources.Original:
Will print the status of your Job's Opener to chat.
e.g. When it is Ready, Fails, or Finishes.
resources.Translated:
将打印您的工作开场白的状态以进行聊天。
例如当它准备就绪、失败或完成时。
聚焦目标 > 硬目标 > 自我
重新定位（单一目标）治疗行动

resources.Original: Show a message on-screen whenever a tankbuster is detected, including who it is targeting.
resources.Translated: 每当检测到坦克杀手时，就会在屏幕上显示一条消息，包括它的目标是谁。

resources.Original: Opener Status in Server Info Bar
resources.Translated: 服务器信息栏中的开启器状态

resources.Original:
Will add any UI MouseOver targets to the top of the Default Heal Stack, overriding the rest of the stack if you are mousing over any party member UI.

It is recommended to enable this if you are a keyboard+mouse user and enable Retarget Healing Actions (or have UI MouseOver targets in your Redirect/Reaction configuration).
resources.Translated:
将把任何 UI MouseOver 目标添加到默认治疗堆栈的顶部，如果您将鼠标悬停在任何团队成员 UI 上，则会覆盖堆栈的其余部分。

如果您是键盘+鼠标用户并启用重定向修复操作（或者在重定向/反应配置中有 UI MouseOver 目标），建议启用此功能。

resources.Original: Open PvE Features Tab to Current Job on Switching Jobs
resources.Translated: 切换作业时打开当前作业的 PvE 功能选项卡

resources.Original: 0.0-1.0 (Above that gets into the territory of breaking any Movement Options in your Job)
resources.Translated: 0.0-1.0（高于此值就进入破坏工作中任何移动选项的范围）

resources.Original: Setting this too low or to zero will make it really hard to manually queue.
resources.Translated: 将其设置得太低或为零将使手动排队变得非常困难。

resources.Original:
Will add any MouseOver targets to the top of the Default Heal Stack, overriding the rest of the stack if you are mousing over any party member UI.

It is recommended to enable this if you are a keyboard+mouse user and enable Retarget Healing Actions (or have UI MouseOver targets in your Redirect/Reaction configuration).
resources.Translated:
将把任何 MouseOver 目标添加到默认治疗堆栈的顶部，如果您将鼠标悬停在任何队伍成员 UI 上，则会覆盖堆栈的其余部分。

如果您是键盘+鼠标用户并启用重定向修复操作（或者在重定向/反应配置中有 UI MouseOver 目标），建议启用此功能。

resources.Original: Draws a box around party members in the vanilla Party List, when targeted by certain Features.
resources.Translated: 当被某些功能定位时，在原版队伍列表中的队伍成员周围绘制一个方框。

resources.Original:
Controls the percentage of a total cast time to wait before interrupting enemy casts.
Applies to all interrupts (including stuns used to interrupt) in every Job's Combos.
resources.Translated:
控制在打断敌人施法之前等待的总施法时间的百分比。
适用于每个作业组合中的所有中断（包括用于中断的眩晕）。

resources.Original: On, cause it's that type of day y'know
resources.Translated: 继续，因为这是你知道的那种日子

resources.Original: This will add your focus target under your hard and soft targets in the Default Heal Stack, overriding the rest of the stack if you have a living focus target.
resources.Translated: 这会将您的焦点目标添加到默认治疗堆栈中的硬目标和软目标下，如果您有活的焦点目标，则会覆盖堆栈的其余部分。

resources.Original:
This controls how long of a delay is needed before Wrath recognizes you as moving.
This allows you to not have to worry about small movements affecting your rotation, primarily for casters.
resources.Translated:
这控制了愤怒之神识别出你正在移动之前需要多长时间的延迟。
这使您不必担心小动作会影响您的旋转，尤其是脚轮。

resources.Original: Will allow you to queue when the GCD is at this time or less.
resources.Translated: 当GCD在这个时间或更短的时间时，将允许你排队。
在 Tankbuster 上显示 Toast

resources.Original: Add UI MouseOver to the Default Healing Stack
resources.Translated: 将 UI MouseOver 添加到默认修复堆栈

resources.Original: For when you can't get enough MNK in your plugin.
resources.Translated: 当你在插件中无法获得足够的 MNK 时。

resources.Original: On (If you customize the Heal Stack AT ALL)
resources.Translated: 打开（如果您完全自定义治疗堆栈）

resources.Original:
Wrath is largely designed with Action Replacing in mind.
Only Auto-Rotation will work if this is disabled.
Disabling it may also lead to unexpected behavior, such as regarding Retargeting.
resources.Translated:
愤怒的设计很大程度上考虑了行动替代。
如果禁用此功能，则只有自动旋转才会起作用。
禁用它还可能导致意外行为，例如重定向。

resources.Original: Open Wrath to the PvE Features Tab
resources.Translated: 打开《愤怒》PvE 功能选项卡

resources.Original: Add Focus Target to the Default Healing Stack
resources.Translated: 将焦点目标添加到默认治疗堆栈中

resources.Original: Controls the color of the box drawn around party members.
resources.Translated: 控制围绕队伍成员绘制的框的颜色。

resources.Original: When the PvE Features tab is opened it will automatically open to your current Job.
resources.Translated: 当 PvE 功能选项卡打开时，它将自动打开您当前的作业。

resources.Original:
Controls how many oGCDs are allowed between GCDs.
The 'default' for the game is double weaving, but triple weaving is completely possible with low enough latency (of every kind);but if you struggle with latency of any sort then single weaving may even be a good answer to try for you.
Triple weaving is already done in a manner where we try to avoid clipping GCDs, and as such doesn't happen particularly often even if you have good latency, and is a valid thing to do, so it is a safe option if you want.
resources.Translated:
控制 GCD 之间允许有多少个 oGCD。
游戏的“默认”是双重编织，但三重编织完全可以在足够低的延迟（每种类型）的情况下进行；但如果您遇到任何类型的延迟，那么单编织甚至可能是您尝试的一个很好的答案。
三重编织已经以我们试图避免剪裁 GCD 的方式完成，因此即使您有良好的延迟，这种情况也不会经常发生，并且是有效的做法，因此如果您愿意，它是一个安全的选择。

resources.Original: Will play a text-to-speech sound clip whenever a stack/group damage cast is detected, including who it is targeting if applicable.
resources.Translated: 每当检测到堆栈/组伤害施放时，就会播放文本转语音的声音剪辑，包括目标对象（如果适用）。

resources.Original: Will play a text-to-speech sound clip whenever a tankbuster is detected, including who it is targeting.
resources.Translated: 每当检测到坦克杀手时，就会播放文本到语音的声音剪辑，包括它的目标是谁。
将开启器状态输出到聊天

resources.Original: Will prevent the Message of the Day from being shown in your chat upon login.
resources.Translated: 将阻止登录后在聊天中显示每日消息。

resources.Original:
This will add any NPCs that are not in your party to the retargeting logic for healing actions.

Useful for healers who want to be able to target NPCs that are not in their party, such as quest NPCs.
These NPCs will not generally work with any role-based custom Heal Stack entries
(even if an NPC looks like a tank, they're not always classified as one)
resources.Translated:
这会将不在您队伍中的任何 NPC 添加到治疗操作的重定向逻辑中。

对于希望能够瞄准不在队伍中的 NPC（例如任务 NPC）的治疗者很有用。
这些 NPC 通常不会与任何基于角色的自定义治疗堆栈条目一起使用
（即使 NPC 看起来像坦克，但它们并不总是被归类为坦克）

resources.Original:
Will completely block actions while moving.
This would supersede combo-specific movement options, which many jobs have.
resources.Translated:
移动时会完全阻止动作。
这将取代许多工作都有的特定于组合的移动选项。

resources.Original: Will draw a border around Combos and Features that have Features and Options of their own.
resources.Translated: 将在具有自己的功能和选项的组合和功能周围绘制边框。

resources.Original: Controls whether Search Bars should be shown in Settings, and PvE and PvP Jobs.
resources.Translated: 控制是否应在“设置”以及 PvE 和 PvP 作业中显示搜索栏。

resources.Original: Off (Most Jobs will handle this better with their Features)
resources.Translated: 关闭（大多数工作会通过其功能更好地处理这个问题）
抑制自动旋转命令反馈

resources.Original: On (IF trying to report an issue)
resources.Translated: 开启（如果尝试报告问题）

resources.Original: This will add a nearby party member with the lowest HP% to bottom of the Default Heal Stack, overriding only yourself.
resources.Translated: 这会将附近 HP% 最低的队员添加到默认治疗堆栈的底部，仅覆盖您自己。

resources.Original: This will allow you to overwrite whatever is currently queued up with another action.
resources.Translated: 这将允许您用另一个操作覆盖当前排队的任何内容。

resources.Original: below 40 (Above that and you start failing to interrupt many short casts)
resources.Translated: 低于 40（高于此值，你开始无法打断许多短施法）

resources.Original: On (If you use Retargeting at all)
resources.Translated: 开启（如果您使用重定向）

resources.Original: Off, unless your name starts with Beep
resources.Translated: 关闭，除非您的名字以 Beep 开头

resources.Original: Show Preset IDs next to Combo Names
resources.Translated: 在组合名称旁边显示预设 ID

resources.Original:
Displays the Preset ID number next to the name of each Combo and Feature.
These are the IDs used for commands like `/wrath toggle <ID>`.
Pre-7.3 the behavior was to show a number here, but it was much shorter, and did not work in commands.
resources.Translated:
在每个组合和功能名称旁边显示预设 ID 号。
这些是用于“/wrathtoggle <ID>”等命令的 ID。
7.3 之前的行为是在此处显示数字，但它要短得多，并且在命令中不起作用。

resources.Original:
This is the order in which Wrath will try to select a target to Raise,
if Retargeting of any Raise Feature is enabled.

You can find Raise Features under PvE>General,
or under each caster that has a Raise.

If there are fewer than 5 items, and all return nothing when checked, will fall back to:
your Hard Target if they're dead, or <Any Dead Party Member>.

These targets will only be considered valid if they are friendly, dead, and within 30y.
resources.Translated:
这是愤怒尝试选择提升目标的顺序，
如果启用了任何提升功能的重定向。

您可以在 PvE>常规下找到提升功能，
或在每个有提升的脚轮下方。

如果项目少于 5 个，并且在检查时全部不返回任何内容，则将回退到：
你的硬目标（如果他们死了），或者<任何死去的党员>。

这些目标只有在友方、死亡且在 30 年内才会被视为有效。

resources.Original: Open Wrath to the PvP Features Tab in PvP areas
resources.Translated: 打开 PvP 区域中 PvP 功能选项卡的愤怒

resources.Original:
This is a new way of evaluating current HP values, using pre-emptively obtained values to update health values internally before it is reflected in-game properly.

As such, you may see things happen earlier than what may be expected, as values for damage and healing are generated much earlier than shown in game. For example, as soon as you hit the slidecast window the value of the spell is already known.

This is actually best recommended for healers using auto-rotation to mitigate the amount of double casted heals. For DPS, this will switch targets with auto-rotation the moment a killing blow goes out, rather than waiting until the target is officially recognized as dead.

Used currently when evaluating HP% checks in features and auto-rotation.
resources.Translated:
这是一种评估当前 HP 值的新方法，使用预先获取的值在内部更新健康值，然后再正确反映在游戏中。

因此，您可能会看到事情发生得比预期早，因为伤害和治疗值的生成比游戏中显示的要早得多。例如，一旦您点击幻灯片窗口，咒语的值就已经知道了。

实际上，最好建议治疗者使用自动旋转来减少双施法治疗量。对于DPS来说，这将在致命一击结束时自动旋转目标，而不是等到目标被正式确认死亡。

当前在评估功能和自动旋转中的 HP% 检查时使用。

resources.Original: Show a message on-screen whenever a stack/group damage cast is detected, including who it is targeting if applicable.
resources.Translated: 每当检测到堆叠/群体伤害时，都会在屏幕上显示一条消息，包括目标是谁（如果适用）。

resources.Original: Add Field MouseOver to the Default Healing Stack
resources.Translated: 将 Field MouseOver 添加到默认治疗堆栈

resources.Original:
Will hide the number of active Auto-Mode Combos.
By default the Server Info Bar shows:
- Whether Auto-Rotation is on or off
- (if on) The number of active Auto-Mode Combos
- (if applicable) Whether another plugin is controlling the state of Auto-Rotation.
resources.Translated:
将隐藏活动自动模式组合的数量。
默认情况下，服务器信息栏显示：
- 自动旋转是否打开或关闭
-（如果打开）活动自动模式组合的数量
-（如果适用）是否有另一个插件正在控制自动旋转的状态。
在 Tankbuster 上播放 TTS

resources.Original: Show Borders around Combos and Features with Options
resources.Translated: 使用选项显示组合和功能周围的边框

resources.Original: Open PvE Features Tab to Current Job on Opening
resources.Translated: 打开时打开当前作业的 PvE 功能选项卡

resources.Original: Shows the status of your current opener, if enabled and applicable.
resources.Translated: 显示当前开启程序的状态（如果已启用且适用）。
在团体伤害上播放 TTS

resources.Original: Will hide the Features and Options under disabled Combos.
resources.Translated: 将隐藏禁用组合下的功能和选项。

resources.Original: Use a Custom Heal Stack Instead
resources.Translated: 使用自定义治疗堆栈代替

resources.Original: Add Lowest HP% Ally to the Default Healing Stack
resources.Translated: 将最低 HP% 盟友添加到默认治疗堆栈中

resources.Original:
Select this if you would rather make your own stack of target priorities for Heal Targets instead of using our default stack.

It is recommended to use this to align with your Redirect/Reaction configuration IF you're not using the Retarget Healing Actions option above; otherwise it is preference.
resources.Translated:
如果您希望为治疗目标创建自己的目标优先级堆栈而不是使用我们的默认堆栈，请选择此选项。

如果您没有使用上面的“重定向修复操作”选项，建议使用此选项来与您的重定向/反应配置保持一致；否则就是偏好。

resources.Original:
Controls what is considered to be in melee range.
Mainly for those who don't want to switch to ranged attacks if the boss walks slightly outside of range.
For example a value of -0.5 would make you have to be 0.5 yalms closer to the target,
or a value of 2 would allow you to be 2 yalms further away and still be considered in melee range
(melee actions wouldn't work, but it would give you some warning instead of just suddenly doing less optimal actions).
resources.Translated:
控制近战范围内的范围。
主要针对那些不想在 Boss 稍微超出范围时切换为远程攻击的人。
例如，值为 -0.5 将使您必须距离目标更近 0.5 yalm，
或者值为 2 将使您距离更远 2 亚尔姆，但仍被视为在近战范围内
（近战动作不起作用，但它会给你一些警告，而不是突然做出不太理想的动作）。

resources.Original: Will hide Combos that conflict with Combos that you have enabled.
resources.Translated: 将隐藏与您已启用的组合冲突的组合。

resources.Original:
If there are fewer than 4 items, and all return nothing when checked, will fall back to Self.

These targets will only be considered valid if they are friendly and within 25y.

When applied to something like Esuna, these targets will be checked for having a Cleansable Debuff, etc.
So adding 'Any Cleansable Ally' or similar is not necessary.
resources.Translated:
如果项目少于 4 个，并且在检查时都没有返回任何内容，则将回退到 Self。

这些目标只有在友好且 25 年内才会被视为有效。

当应用于像埃苏纳这样的目标时，将检查这些目标是否具有可清理减益等。
因此，没有必要添加“任何可清洁盟友”或类似内容。

resources.Original: Increase with higher latency to the server
resources.Translated: 随着服务器延迟的增加而增加
缩短服务器信息栏文本
实验性 HP 检查功能

resources.Original: Will hide chat feedback for /wrath auto commands
resources.Translated: 将隐藏 /wrath 自动命令的聊天反馈

resources.Original:
Same as above, when you open Wrath with `/wrath`, it will open to the PvP Features tab, instead of the last tab you were on, when in a PvP area.
Similar to using the `/wrath pvp` command to open Wrath.
resources.Translated:
与上面相同，当您使用“/wrath”打开“愤怒”时，在 PvP 区域中，它将打开“PvP 功能”选项卡，而不是您上次打开的选项卡。
与使用“/wrath pvp”命令打开“愤怒”类似。

resources.Original:
Will hide chat feedback for /wrath set and /wrath unset commands.
(Will still show feedback if the command is being overriden by IPC, or fails)
resources.Translated:
将隐藏 /wrath set 和 /wrath unset 命令的聊天反馈。
（如果命令被 IPC 覆盖或失败，仍然会显示反馈）

resources.Original: Any Healer > Any Tank > Any Raiser > Any Dead Party Member
resources.Translated: 任何治疗者 > 任何坦克 > 任何提升者 > 任何死去的队员

resources.Original:
Controls whether Actions on your Hotbar will be Replaced with combos from the plugin.
If disabled, your manual presses of abilities will no longer be affected by any Wrath settings.

Auto-Rotation will work regardless of the setting.
resources.Translated:
控制热栏上的操作是否将替换为插件中的组合。
如果禁用，您手动按下的技能将不再受到任何愤怒设置的影响。

无论设置如何，自动旋转都会起作用。

resources.Original:
Controls how long of a gap with no action is allowed in an Opener, before it is considered failed and normal rotation is resumed.
Can be necessary for some casters to increase, particularly when the first action of an Opener is a hard-cast.
resources.Translated:
控制开启器中允许有多长时间没有任何操作的间隙，然后才将其视为失败并恢复正常旋转。
对于某些施法者来说可能有必要增加施法者，特别是当开场者的第一个动作是硬施法时。

resources.Original:
When you open Wrath with `/wrath`, it will open to the PvE Features tab, instead of the last tab you were on.
Same as always using the `/wrath pve` command to open Wrath.
resources.Translated:
当您使用“/wrath”打开“Wrath”时，它将打开“PvE 功能”选项卡，而不是您上次打开的选项卡。
与通常使用“/wrath pve”命令打开“愤怒”相同。

resources.Original: On (IF trying to troubleshoot an Opener)
resources.Translated: 开启（如果尝试对 Opener 进行故障排除）

resources.Original: On (This is essentially turning OFF most of Wrath)
resources.Translated: 打开（这实际上是关闭大部分愤怒）
将党外 NPC 添加到重定向中

resources.Original: Allows you to adjust your queue window to any time during the GCD rather than just within the last 0.3-0.5s. Useful if you're not mashing the key or using Auto-Rotation and wish to manually intervene.
resources.Translated: 允许您将队列窗口调整为 GCD 期间的任何时间，而不仅仅是最后 0.3-0.5 秒内。如果您不敲击按键或使用自动旋转并希望手动干预，则非常有用。

resources.Original:
Will lockout combos on your hotbar when detected mechanics that inflict a penalty for using an action is detected (e.g pyretics, acceleration bombs, gazes etc.) has this much time left before resolving.

Some mechanics may override this value.

Set to 0 to disable.
resources.Translated:
当检测到因使用动作而受到惩罚的机制（例如发热、加速炸弹、凝视等）在解决之前还剩这么多时间时，将锁定热键栏上的连击。

某些机制可能会覆盖该值。

设置为 0 以禁用。

resources.Original: This is highly experimental, and may have undesired behaviours. Please be vigilant and report this.
resources.Translated: 这是高度实验性的，可能会出现不良行为。请保持警惕并报告此事。

resources.Original: (Only used by AST and DNC currently)
Will automatically switch the PvE Features tab to the job you are currently playing, when you switch jobs.
resources.Translated: 当您切换职业时，将自动将 PvE 功能选项卡切换到您当前正在玩的职业。

resources.Original:
Will Retarget all Single-Target Healing Actions to the Heal Stack as shown below,
similarly to how Redirect or Reaction would.
This ensures that the target used to check HP% threshold logic for healing actions is the same target that will receive that heal.
resources.Translated:
将把所有单目标治疗动作重新定位到治疗堆栈，如下所示，
类似于重定向或反应的方式。
这确保了用于检查治疗动作的 HP% 阈值逻辑的目标与将接收该治疗的目标是同一目标。

resources.Original: Will print to chat every time you use an action provided by Wrath.
resources.Translated: 每次使用 Wrath 提供的操作时都会打印出来聊天。
4.0-7.0（以上确实可以拧螺丝开瓶器）

resources.Original:
Unlike the other Default+ Options, this one is not an option in most other Retargeting Plugins.
THIS SHOULD BE USED WITH THE 'RETARGET HEALING ACTIONS' SETTING ABOVE!
resources.Translated:
与其他默认+选项不同，大多数其他重定向插件中都没有此选项。
这应该与上面的“重新定位治疗行动”设置一起使用！

resources.Original:
Will restrict how often Combos will update the Action on your Hotbar.
At 50ms it's not really restrictive, always giving you an up to date action.

If you are looking for some (fairly minor) FPS gains then you can increase this value to make Combos run less often.
This makes your combos less responsive, and perhaps even clips GCDs.
At high values this will clip your GCDs by several seconds or break your rotation altogether.
resources.Translated:
将限制组合更新热键栏上操作的频率。
50 毫秒并没有真正的限制，始终为您提供最新的操作。

如果您正在寻找一些（相当小的）FPS 增益，那么您可以增加此值以减少组合运行的频率。
这会降低你的连击反应速度，甚至可能会削弱 GCD。
如果值较高，这将使您的 GCD 缩短几秒钟或完全破坏您的旋转。

resources.Original: Suppress Set and Unset commands feedback
resources.Translated: 抑制设置和取消设置命令反馈

resources.Original:
This is the order in which Wrath will try to select a healing target. 
If the 'Retarget Healing Actions' option is disabled, that is just the target that will be used for checking the HP threshold to trigger different healing actions to show up in their rotations. 
That means that if your own retargeting solution (Redirect, Reaction, etc) does not match this then Wrath can stick you in a loop of healing the wrong target!!! 
If the 'Retarget Healing Actions' option is enabled, that target is also the one that healing actions will be targeted onto (even when the action does not first check the HP of that target, like the combo's Replaced Action, for example).
resources.Translated:
这是愤怒尝试选择治疗目标的顺序。 
如果禁用“重新定位治疗动作”选项，则该目标将仅用于检查生命值阈值以触发不同的治疗动作以显示在其轮换中。 
这意味着，如果您自己的重定向解决方案（重定向、反应等）与此不匹配，那么“愤怒”可能会让您陷入治疗错误目标的循环！ 
如果启用了“重新定位治疗动作”选项，则该目标也是治疗动作的目标目标（即使该动作没有首先检查该目标的生命值，例如组合的替换动作）。

resources.Original: This Feature will involve retargeting actions if enabled.
resources.Translated: 如果启用，此功能将涉及重定向操作。

resources.Original:
The actions this Feature affects will automatically be
targeted onto the targets in the priority you have configured.
resources.Translated:
此功能影响的操作将自动
以您配置的优先级定位到目标。

resources.Original:
Using plugins like Redirect or Reaction with configurations
affecting the same actions will Conflict and may cause issues.
resources.Translated:
使用重定向或反应等插件进行配置
影响相同的操作会发生冲突并可能导致问题。

resources.Original:
This is the order in which Wrath will try to select a raise target,
if Retargeting of any Raise Feature is enabled.
resources.Translated:
这是愤怒尝试选择加注目标的顺序，
如果启用了任何提升功能的重定向。

resources.Original:
Will generate a debug file on your desktop.
Useful to give developers to help troubleshoot issues.
The same as using the following command: /wrath debug
resources.Translated:
将在您的桌面上生成一个调试文件。
有助于开发人员帮助解决问题。
与使用以下命令相同：/wrath debug

resources.Original: Category name, Setting name, Internal Name, etc
resources.Translated: 类别名称、设置名称、内部名称等

resources.Original: This tab allows you to customise global settings for Wrath Combo.
resources.Translated: 此选项卡允许您自定义“愤怒组合”的全局设置。

resources.Original:
YOU are responsible for making sure your retargeting solution matches this heal stack!
If it does not then Wrath can get stuck in a loop where X player is checked and needs healing, but Y player is who gets healed!
resources.Translated:
您有责任确保您的重定向解决方案与此治疗堆栈相匹配！
如果没有，那么“愤怒”可能会陷入一个循环，其中 X 玩家被检查并需要治疗，但 Y 玩家才是得到治疗的人！

resources.Original:
The priority goes from top to bottom.
Scroll down to see all of your items.
Click the Up and Down buttons to move items in the list.
Click the X button to remove an item from the list.
resources.Translated:
优先级从上到下。
向下滚动以查看您的所有项目。
单击向上和向下按钮可移动列表中的项目。
单击 X 按钮可从列表中删除项目。

attributes.Original: The Wrath user manually elected to revoke your lease.
attributes.Translated: Wrath 用户手动选择撤销你的租约。

attributes.Original: Your plugin was detected as having been disabled, not that you're likely to see this.
attributes.Translated: 检测到你的插件已被禁用，虽然你大概看不到这条消息。

attributes.Original: The Wrath plugin is being disabled.
Your lease was released by IPC call, theoretically this was done by you.
attributes.Translated: 你的租约已通过 IPC 调用释放，理论上这是你自己操作的。

attributes.Original: IPC Services have been disabled remotely. Please see the commit history for /res/ipc_status.txt. https://github.com/PunishXIV/WrathCombo/commits/main/res/ipc_status.txt
attributes.Translated: IPC 服务已被远程禁用。请查看 /res/ipc_status.txt 的提交历史。https://github.com/PunishXIV/WrathCombo/commits/main/res/ipc_status.txt

attributes.Original: Player job has been changed and leases will have to be reapplied.
attributes.Translated: 玩家职业已变更，租约需要重新申请。

attributes.Original: A default value that shouldn't ever be seen.
attributes.Translated: 一个不应出现的默认值。

attributes.Original: The configuration will be set, it is working asynchronously.
attributes.Translated: 配置将被设置，正在异步处理。

attributes.Original: Configuration you are trying to set is already set.
attributes.Translated: 你尝试设置的配置已经设置过了。

attributes.Original: The configuration you are trying to set is not available.
attributes.Translated: 你尝试设置的配置不可用。

attributes.Original: The value you are trying to set is invalid.
